//PTS3 Test Client 
// ============================================================
// PTS3 Test - Client Script (Single-Lane Operator Mode)
// Spec: 12_LIVE_UPDATE_FLOW.md, 18_FINAL_DOCTYPE_SPEC_REVISED.md
//
// Single-lane operator console. Uses lane 1 only. Hides data-entry fields.
// PTS3 Result created only when connector calls save_final_result (on completion).
// ============================================================

(function () {
  /** F12 console: filter by [PTS3] */
  function pts3Dbg() {
    try {
      if (typeof console !== "undefined" && console.info) {
        var a = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
        console.info.apply(console, ["[PTS3]"].concat(a));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  const REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS = 1750;
  const LANE_NO = 1;
  const PTS3_SIDEBAR_WIDTH = 180;  // Left sidebar width (px) when on PTS3 Test - edit to reduce/increase
  const PTS3_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED = true;  // Set true to collapse sidebar when opening PTS3 Test

  // Keep last known sweep graph/table visible across Mode runs
  // (ERP live_* fields can be cleared/overwritten when a new action starts)
  const PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY = "__pts3_ui_cache_v1";

  if (document.getElementById("pts3-client-style") == null) {
    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = "pts3-client-style";
    style.textContent = ".pts3-dashboard{max-width:100%;width:100%;}.pts3-lane-box{border:1px solid #d1d8dd;border-radius:4px;padding:1rem;}.pts3-lane-title{margin:0;font-size:1.1rem;}.pts3-station{margin:0;font-size:0.85em;color:#6c7680;}.pts3-header-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;}.pts3-header-left{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;}.pts3-header-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;justify-content:flex-end;}.pts3-header-left .pts3-serial-row{margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;}.pts3-header-left .pts3-serial-row input{width:180px;padding:4px 8px;}.pts3-header-left .pts3-actions{margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;}.pts3-header-left .pts3-actions .btn{margin:0;}.pts3-summary{margin:0.5rem 0;font-size:0.9em;color:#6c7680;}.pts3-summary-item{margin-right:1rem;}.pts3-error{color:#e74c3c;margin:0.5rem 0;}.pts3-progress{color:#3498db;margin:0.5rem 0;}.pts3-playing-freq{font-size:1.1em;color:#2980b9;}.pts3-no-data{color:#8d99a6;font-style:italic;}.pts3-lrd-table,.pts3-graph-table{font-size:0.85em;}.pts3-status-running{color:#3498db;}.pts3-status-requested,.pts3-status-queued{color:#f39c12;}.pts3-status-done{color:#27ae60;}.pts3-status-failed,.pts3-status-aborted{color:#e74c3c;}.pts3-lane-log{font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#1e1e1e;color:#d4d4d4;padding:8px;border-radius:4px;max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;margin-top:0.5rem;}.pts3-charts-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.75rem;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;margin:0.25rem 0;}.pts3-chart-wrap{flex:1 1 48%;min-width:550px;margin:0;overflow-x:auto;}.pts3-chart-wrap svg.pts3-chart-svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}";
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  function slugifySerial(s) {
    if (!s || !String(s).trim()) return "UNKNOWN";
    var t = String(s).trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "");
    return (t.substring(0, 60) || "UNKNOWN");
  }

  /** step_sweep -> sweep; full_test -> full; mode* unchanged — used in document name. */
  function shortLaneAction(lane_action) {
    if (!lane_action || !String(lane_action).trim()) return "na";
    var a = String(lane_action).trim();
    if (a === "step_sweep") return "sweep";
    if (a === "full_test") return "full";
    return a.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, "_").substring(0, 24) || "na";
  }

  frappe.ui.form.on("PTS3 Test", {
    onload: function (frm) {
      ensure_lane1(frm);
      hide_operator_fields(frm);
      apply_full_width_form(frm);
    },
    before_save: function (frm) {
      ensure_lane1(frm);
      var row = (frm.doc.lanes || []).find(function (r) {
        return parseInt(r.lane_no, 10) === LANE_NO;
      });
      var serial = row && row.pcb_serial_no ? row.pcb_serial_no : "";
      var action = row && row.lane_action ? row.lane_action : "";
      if (frm.fields_dict.name_serial_slug) {
        frm.doc.name_serial_slug = slugifySerial(serial);
      }
      if (frm.fields_dict.name_op_short) {
        frm.doc.name_op_short = shortLaneAction(action);
      }
    },
    refresh: function (frm) {
      ensure_lane1(frm);
      hide_operator_fields(frm);
      render_lane_dashboard(frm);
      start_auto_refresh_if_needed(frm);
    }
  });

  function hide_operator_fields(frm) {
    var hidden = ["naming_series", "name_serial_slug", "name_op_short", "test_status", "station_name", "operator", "remarks"];
    hidden.forEach(function (fn) {
      if (frm.fields_dict[fn]) {
        frm.set_df_property(fn, "hidden", 1);
      }
    });
    // target_pc must stay visible (or at least not hidden): hidden Data fields often reject
    // frm.set_value in the browser, so the Station box could not update the document.
    if (frm.fields_dict.target_pc) {
      frm.set_df_property("target_pc", "hidden", 0);
      frm.set_df_property("target_pc", "read_only", 0);
    }
    if (frm.fields_dict.lanes) {
      frm.set_df_property("lanes", "hidden", 1);
    }
  }

  function ensure_lane1(frm) {
    var lanes = frm.doc.lanes || [];
    var has1 = lanes.some(function (r) { return parseInt(r.lane_no, 10) === LANE_NO; });
    if (!has1) {
      var row = frm.add_child("lanes");
      row.lane_no = LANE_NO;
      row.lane_action_status = "Idle";
      row.lane_action = "";
      row.pcb_serial_no = "";
      frm.refresh_field("lanes");
    }
  }

  function apply_full_width_form(frm) {
    frm.$wrapper.parents(".form-layout, .form-container, .layout-main, .page-content").addClass("pts3-full-width-form");
    document.body.classList.add("pts3-test-page");
    setTimeout(collapse_sidebar_for_pts3, 100);
    if (!window.__pts3_route_cleanup) {
      window.__pts3_route_cleanup = true;
      frappe.router.on("change", function () {
        var r = frappe.router.current_route || [];
        if (r[0] !== "Form" || r[1] !== "PTS3 Test") {
          $(".form-layout, .form-container, .layout-main, .page-content").removeClass("pts3-full-width-form");
          document.body.classList.remove("pts3-test-page");
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function collapse_sidebar_for_pts3() {
    try {
      if (frappe.desk && frappe.desk.sidebar && typeof frappe.desk.sidebar.collapse === "function") {
        frappe.desk.sidebar.collapse();
        return;
      }
      if (frappe.ui && frappe.ui.sidebar && typeof frappe.ui.sidebar.collapse === "function") {
        frappe.ui.sidebar.collapse();
        return;
      }
      var $toggle = $(".sidebar-toggle, .menu-btn, [data-toggle='sidebar'], .page-head .menu-btn, .navbar .toggle-sidebar").first();
      if ($toggle.length && !$("body").hasClass("sidebar-collapsed")) {
        $toggle.trigger("click");
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // -----------------------
  // 2. Button actions (server API only, internal codes)
  // -----------------------
  function request_lane_action(frm, lane_no, action) {
    if (!frm.doc.name) {
      frappe.msgprint(__("Save the document first."));
      return;
    }
    var serial = get_lane_field(frm, lane_no, "pcb_serial_no") || "";
    if (!serial.trim()) {
      frappe.msgprint(__("Enter PCB Serial No before requesting action."));
      return;
    }
    frappe.call({
      method: "pts3_api",
      args: {
        api_cmd: "request_lane_action",
        docname: frm.doc.name,
        lane_no: lane_no,
        action: action
      },
      callback: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("request_lane_action response", r && r.message ? r.message : r);
        if (r && r.message && r.message.ok) {
          frm.reload_doc();
        } else if (r && r.message && r.message.reason) {
          frappe.msgprint(__("Request failed: {0}", [r.message.reason]));
        } else if (r && r.exc) {
          frappe.msgprint(__("Request failed: {0}", [r.exc]));
        }
      },
      error: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("request_lane_action error", r);
      }
    });
  }

  function request_abort(frm, lane_no) {
    frappe.call({
      method: "pts3_api",
      args: {
        api_cmd: "request_abort",
        docname: frm.doc.name,
        lane_no: lane_no
      },
      callback: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("request_abort response", r && r.message ? r.message : r);
        if (r && r.message && r.message.ok) {
          frm.reload_doc();
        }
      },
      error: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("request_abort error", r);
      }
    });
  }

  function reset_lane(frm, lane_no) {
    frappe.call({
      method: "pts3_api",
      args: {
        api_cmd: "reset_lane",
        docname: frm.doc.name,
        lane_no: lane_no
      },
      callback: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("reset_lane response", r && r.message ? r.message : r);
        if (r && r.message && r.message.ok) {
          frm.reload_doc();
        }
      },
      error: function (r) {
        pts3Dbg("reset_lane error", r);
      }
    });
  }

  function get_lane_row(frm, lane_no) {
    var lanes = frm.doc.lanes || [];
    return lanes.find(function (r) { return parseInt(r.lane_no, 10) === parseInt(lane_no, 10); }) || null;
  }

  function get_lane_field(frm, lane_no, field) {
    var row = get_lane_row(frm, lane_no);
    return row ? row[field] : "";
  }

  // -----------------------
  // 3. Auto-refresh loop + snapshot merge
  // -----------------------
  function is_active_status(s) {
    var lower = (s || "").toLowerCase();
    return lower === "requested" || lower === "queued" || lower === "running";
  }

  function start_auto_refresh_if_needed(frm) {
    if (frm.__pts3_refresh_timer) {
      clearInterval(frm.__pts3_refresh_timer);
      frm.__pts3_refresh_timer = null;
    }

    var lane1 = get_lane_row(frm, LANE_NO);
    var active = lane1 ? is_active_status(lane1.lane_action_status) : false;

    if (!active || !frm.doc.name) return;

    frm.__pts3_refresh_timer = setInterval(function () {
      frappe.call({
        method: "pts3_api",
        args: {
          api_cmd: "get_status_snapshot",
          docname: frm.doc.name
        },
        callback: function (r) {
          if (!r || !r.message || !r.message.ok) {
            pts3Dbg("get_status_snapshot not ok", r);
            return;
          }
          const data = r.message;
          const snapshot_lanes = data.lanes || [];
          var L1 = snapshot_lanes.find(function (x) { return parseInt(x.lane_no, 10) === LANE_NO; });
          if (L1) {
            pts3Dbg(
              "snapshot lane1 status=" + (L1.lane_action_status || "") +
                " latest_result_id=" + (L1.latest_result_id || "") +
                " live_graph_len=" + String(L1.live_graph_json || "").length +
                " live_table_len=" + String(L1.live_table_json || "").length
            );
          }

          merge_snapshot_into_form(frm, snapshot_lanes);
          render_lane_dashboard(frm);

          const stillActive = snapshot_lanes.some(function (L) {
            return is_active_status(L.lane_action_status);
          });
          if (!stillActive && frm.__pts3_refresh_timer) {
            clearInterval(frm.__pts3_refresh_timer);
            frm.__pts3_refresh_timer = null;
            pts3Dbg("auto-refresh stopped (lane no longer active)");
          }
        },
        error: function (r) {
          pts3Dbg("get_status_snapshot error", r);
        }
      });
    }, REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  function merge_snapshot_into_form(frm, snapshot_lanes) {
    if (!frm[PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY]) frm[PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY] = {};
    const cache = frm[PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY];
    const lanes = frm.doc.lanes || [];
    function merge_mode_values_cache(ln, incomingStr) {
      if (!incomingStr) return;
      let incoming;
      try {
        incoming = typeof incomingStr === "string" ? JSON.parse(incomingStr) : incomingStr;
      } catch (e) {
        incoming = null;
      }
      if (!incoming || typeof incoming !== "object") return;
      if (!cache[ln]) cache[ln] = {};
      let base = {};
      if (cache[ln].mode_values_json) {
        try {
          base = JSON.parse(cache[ln].mode_values_json);
        } catch (e2) {
          base = {};
        }
      }
      if (!base || typeof base !== "object") base = {};
      Object.keys(incoming).forEach(function (k) {
        base[k] = incoming[k];
      });
      try {
        cache[ln].mode_values_json = JSON.stringify(base);
      } catch (e3) {}
    }
    snapshot_lanes.forEach(function (snap) {
      const ln = parseInt(snap.lane_no, 10);
      const row = lanes.find(function (r) {
        return parseInt(r.lane_no, 10) === ln;
      });
      if (row) {
        row.lane_action_status = snap.lane_action_status || row.lane_action_status;
        row.live_graph_json = snap.live_graph_json !== undefined ? snap.live_graph_json : row.live_graph_json;
        row.live_table_json = snap.live_table_json !== undefined ? snap.live_table_json : row.live_table_json;
        row.mode_values_json = snap.mode_values_json !== undefined ? snap.mode_values_json : row.mode_values_json;
        row.live_status = snap.live_status !== undefined ? snap.live_status : row.live_status;
        row.live_current_freq = snap.live_current_freq !== undefined ? snap.live_current_freq : row.live_current_freq;
        row.live_current_mode = snap.live_current_mode !== undefined ? snap.live_current_mode : row.live_current_mode;
        row.live_progress_message = snap.live_progress_message !== undefined ? snap.live_progress_message : row.live_progress_message;
        row.pass_fail = snap.pass_fail !== undefined ? snap.pass_fail : row.pass_fail;
        row.dominant_channel = snap.dominant_channel !== undefined ? snap.dominant_channel : row.dominant_channel;
        row.max_value = snap.max_value !== undefined ? snap.max_value : row.max_value;
        row.latest_result_id = snap.latest_result_id !== undefined ? snap.latest_result_id : row.latest_result_id;
        row.error_message = snap.error_message !== undefined ? snap.error_message : row.error_message;
        row.lane_log = snap.lane_log !== undefined ? snap.lane_log : row.lane_log;

        // Cache: only update when incoming value is non-empty
        if (!cache[ln]) cache[ln] = {};
        if (snap.live_graph_json) cache[ln].live_graph_json = snap.live_graph_json;
        if (snap.live_table_json) cache[ln].live_table_json = snap.live_table_json;
        if (snap.mode_values_json) {
          merge_mode_values_cache(ln, snap.mode_values_json);
        } else if (snap.live_table_json) {
          // Some flows may emit Mode1.. keys inside live_table_json; merge that too.
          merge_mode_values_cache(ln, snap.live_table_json);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // -----------------------
  // 4. Dashboard HTML (single lane card)
  // -----------------------
  function render_lane_dashboard(frm) {
    var container = frm.fields_dict.lane_dashboard && frm.fields_dict.lane_dashboard.$wrapper;
    if (!container) return;

    var lane = get_lane_row(frm, LANE_NO);
    if (!lane) return;

    var status = lane.lane_action_status || "Idle";
    var serial = lane.pcb_serial_no || "";
    var isActive = is_active_status(status);
    var html = '<div class="pts3-dashboard">';
    html += '<div class="pts3-lane-box" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">';
    html += '<div class="pts3-header-row">';
    html += '<div class="pts3-header-left">';
    html += '<div class="pts3-serial-row"><label>PCB Serial No:</label> ';
    html += '<input type="text" class="pts3-serial-input" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" value="' + escape_html(serial) + '" placeholder="Enter serial" />';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-save-serial">Save</button></div>';

    html += '<div class="pts3-actions">';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="step_sweep">Step Sweep</button>';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="mode1">Mode 1</button>';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="mode2">Mode 2</button>';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="mode3">Mode 3</button>';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="mode0">Mode 0</button>';
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-action" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '" data-action="full_test">Full Test</button>';
    if (isActive) {
      html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger pts3-btn-stop" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">Stop</button>';
    }
    html += '<button class="btn btn-sm btn-default pts3-btn-reset" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">Reset</button>';
    html += "</div>";
    html += '<div class="pts3-header-right">';
    html += '<h4 class="pts3-lane-title"><span class="pts3-status pts3-status-' + status.toLowerCase() + '">' + escape_html(status) + '</span></h4>';
    html += '<p class="pts3-station-hint" style="margin:0;font-size:0.85em;color:#6c7680;">Station: edit <strong>Target PC</strong> in the form above, then Save.</p>';
    html += "</div></div>";

    html += '<div class="pts3-summary">';
    html += '<span class="pts3-summary-item">Pass/Fail: ' + escape_html(lane.pass_fail || "-") + '</span> ';
    html += '<span class="pts3-summary-item">Dominant: ' + escape_html(lane.dominant_channel || "-") + '</span> ';
    html += '<span class="pts3-summary-item">Max: ' + (lane.max_value != null ? lane.max_value : "-") + '</span> ';
    if (lane.latest_result_id) {
      html += '<span class="pts3-summary-item"><a href="#Form/PTS3 Result/' + encodeURIComponent(lane.latest_result_id) + '" target="_blank">' + escape_html(lane.latest_result_id) + "</a></span>";
    }
    html += "</div>";

    if (lane.error_message) {
      html += '<div class="pts3-error">' + escape_html(lane.error_message) + "</div>";
    }

    if (isActive && (lane.live_progress_message || lane.live_current_freq != null)) {
      var playingText = lane.live_current_freq != null ? ("Playing: " + lane.live_current_freq + " Hz") : escape_html(lane.live_progress_message || "");
      html += '<div class="pts3-progress pts3-playing-freq"><strong>' + playingText + '</strong></div>';
    }

    html += '<div class="pts3-live-graph" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">';
    html += render_live_graph(lane, frm);
    html += "</div>";

    html += '<div class="pts3-live-table" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">';
    html += render_live_table(lane, frm);
    html += "</div>";

    var laneLog = (lane.lane_log || "").trim();
    if (laneLog || isActive) {
      html += '<div class="pts3-lane-log-wrap" style="margin-top:0.75rem;"><strong>Scope / Connector Log</strong>';
      html += '<div class="pts3-lane-log" data-lane="' + LANE_NO + '">' + escape_html(laneLog || "(waiting for output...)") + "</div></div>";
    }

    html += "</div></div>";
    container.html(html);

    container.find(".pts3-serial-input").on("change", function () {
      var val = $(this).val() || "";
      var row = get_lane_row(frm, LANE_NO);
      if (row) {
        row.pcb_serial_no = val;
        frm.dirty();
      }
    });

    container.find(".pts3-btn-save-serial").on("click", function () {
      var serialVal = container.find(".pts3-serial-input").val() || "";
      var row = get_lane_row(frm, LANE_NO);
      if (row) {
        row.pcb_serial_no = serialVal;
      }
      frm.save();
    });

    container.find(".pts3-btn-action").on("click", function () {
      var $btn = $(this);
      request_lane_action(frm, parseInt($btn.data("lane"), 10), $btn.data("action"));
    });
    container.find(".pts3-btn-stop").on("click", function () {
      request_abort(frm, parseInt($(this).data("lane"), 10));
    });
    container.find(".pts3-btn-reset").on("click", function () {
      reset_lane(frm, parseInt($(this).data("lane"), 10));
    });
  }

  function escape_html(s) {
    if (s == null) return "";
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.textContent = String(s);
    return div.innerHTML;
  }

  // -----------------------
  // 5. Live table rendering (Channel as rows: Left, Right, Diff; freqs as columns)
  // -----------------------
  function render_live_table(lane) {
    const raw = lane.live_table_json || get_cached_lane_value(arguments[1], LANE_NO, "live_table_json");
    if (!raw) return '<div class="pts3-no-data">No table data</div>';

    let data;
    try {
      data = typeof raw === "string" ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    } catch (e) {
      return '<div class="pts3-no-data">Invalid JSON</div>';
    }

    if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return '<div class="pts3-no-data">No table data</div>';

    const left = data.left || {};
    const right = data.right || {};
    const diff = data.diff || {};

    const keys = [];
    const seen = {};
    Object.keys(left).forEach(function (k) {
      if (!seen[k]) { seen[k] = true; keys.push(k); }
    });
    Object.keys(right).forEach(function (k) {
      if (!seen[k]) { seen[k] = true; keys.push(k); }
    });
    Object.keys(diff).forEach(function (k) {
      if (!seen[k]) { seen[k] = true; keys.push(k); }
    });

    keys.sort(function (a, b) {
      var ha = parseInt(String(a).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10);
      var hb = parseInt(String(b).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10);
      return (isNaN(ha) ? 0 : ha) - (isNaN(hb) ? 0 : hb);
    });

    const modeKeys = Object.keys(data).filter(function (k) {
      return k !== "left" && k !== "right" && k !== "diff" && k !== "metadata" && data[k] && typeof data[k] === "object";
    });

    let html = '<table class="table table-bordered table-condensed pts3-lrd-table"><thead><tr><th>Channel</th>';
    keys.forEach(function (k) { html += "<th>" + escape_html(k) + "</th>"; });
    html += "</tr></thead><tbody>";

    html += "<tr><td>Left</td>";
    keys.forEach(function (k) { html += "<td>" + format_val(left[k]) + "</td>"; });
    html += "</tr><tr><td>Right</td>";
    keys.forEach(function (k) { html += "<td>" + format_val(right[k]) + "</td>"; });
    html += "</tr><tr><td>Diff</td>";
    keys.forEach(function (k) { html += "<td>" + format_val(diff[k]) + "</td>"; });
    html += "</tr>";

    modeKeys.forEach(function (mk) {
      const m = data[mk];
      if (m && (m.p1 != null || m.p2 != null || m.diff != null)) {
        html += "<tr><td>" + escape_html(mk) + "</td><td colspan=\"" + keys.length + "\">P1=" + format_val(m.p1) + " P2=" + format_val(m.p2) + " Diff=" + format_val(m.diff) + "</td></tr>";
      }
    });

    html += "</tbody></table>";
    return html;
  }

  function format_val(v) {
    if (v == null) return "-";
    if (typeof v === "number") return v.toFixed(2);
    return escape_html(String(v));
  }

  // -----------------------
  // 6. Live graph rendering (SVG chart + row-format table)
  // -----------------------
  // ========== EDIT CHART SETTINGS HERE ==========
  var PTS3_LIMITS = {
    sweep: { yMin: 2000, yMax: 3500, xMin: 40, xMax: 80 },
    diff:  { yMin: -150, yMax: 150, xMin: 40, xMax: 80 }
  };
  // width, height: chart size (px). axisFontSize: axis labels. legendFontSize: legend above chart.
  // lineWidth, diffLineWidth: data line thickness.
  // xMajorInterval: X major tick spacing (Hz). xMinorInterval: X minor grid (Hz).
  // yMajorCount: Y major divisions. yMinorPerMajor: minor lines between majors.
  // gridMajorWidth, gridMinorWidth, gridMinorOpacity: grid. axisWidth: axis.
  var PTS3_CHART_STYLE = {
    width: 1600, height: 700,
    padding: { top: 25, right: 25, bottom: 50, left: 150 },
    axisFontSize: 35, legendFontSize: 14,
    lineWidth: 5, diffLineWidth: 5,
    xMajorInterval: 4, xMinorInterval: 2,
    yMajorCount: 5, yMinorPerMajor: 2,
    gridMajorWidth: 2, gridMinorWidth: 2, gridMinorOpacity: .8,
    axisWidth: 4
  };
  // ==============================================
  var CHART = {
    width: PTS3_CHART_STYLE.width, height: PTS3_CHART_STYLE.height,
    padding: PTS3_CHART_STYLE.padding,
    fontSize: PTS3_CHART_STYLE.axisFontSize != null ? PTS3_CHART_STYLE.axisFontSize : 14,
    fontColor: "var(--text-color, #36414c)",
    lineLeft: "#E53935", lineRight: "#2196F3", lineDiff: "#4CAF50",
    axisColor: "rgba(74,74,74,0.5)",
    gridColor: "rgba(74,74,74,0.35)"
  };

  function render_live_graph(lane, frm) {
    const raw = lane.live_graph_json || get_cached_lane_value(frm, LANE_NO, "live_graph_json");
    if (!raw) return '<div class="pts3-no-data">No graph data</div>';

    let data;
    try {
      data = typeof raw === "string" ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    } catch (e) {
      return '<div class="pts3-no-data">Invalid JSON</div>';
    }

    if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return '<div class="pts3-no-data">No graph data</div>';

    const type = data.type || "sweep";
    const freqs = data.freqs || [];
    const left = data.left || [];
    const right = data.right || [];
    const diff = data.diff || [];

    if (freqs.length === 0 && type === "sweep") {
      return '<div class="pts3-no-data">No sweep points yet</div>';
    }

    var out = "";
    if (freqs.length >= 2) {
      var chartResult = render_sweep_chart_svg(freqs, left, right, diff);
      var diffChartSvg = render_diff_chart_svg(freqs, diff);
      out += '<div class="pts3-charts-row">';
      var legFs = (PTS3_CHART_STYLE.legendFontSize != null ? PTS3_CHART_STYLE.legendFontSize : 13) + "px";
      out += '<div class="pts3-chart-wrap"><p style="font-size:' + legFs + ';margin:0 0 4px 0;color:' + CHART.fontColor + ';"><span style="color:' + CHART.lineLeft + '">—</span> Left &nbsp; <span style="color:' + CHART.lineRight + '">—</span> Right &nbsp; <span style="color:' + CHART.lineDiff + '">- -</span> Diff</p>' + chartResult.svg + '</div>';
      if (diffChartSvg) {
        out += '<div class="pts3-chart-wrap pts3-diff-chart-wrap"><p style="font-size:' + legFs + ';margin:0 0 4px 0;color:' + CHART.fontColor + ';"><span style="color:' + CHART.lineDiff + '">- -</span> Diff vs Hz</p>' + diffChartSvg + '</div>';
      }
      out += '</div>';
    }

    // Mode bar chart (Mode1/2/3/0: Left(P1), Right(P2), Diff)
    var modeSvg = render_mode_bar_chart_from_table(frm, lane);
    if (modeSvg) {
      out += '<div class="pts3-chart-wrap pts3-mode-chart-wrap" style="margin-top:0.75rem;">' +
        '<p style="font-size:' + ((PTS3_CHART_STYLE.legendFontSize != null ? PTS3_CHART_STYLE.legendFontSize : 13) + "px") +
        ';margin:0 0 4px 0;color:' + CHART.fontColor + ';">' +
        '<strong>Mode Values</strong> &nbsp; ' +
        '<span style="color:' + CHART.lineLeft + '">■</span> Left(P1) &nbsp; ' +
        '<span style="color:' + CHART.lineRight + '">■</span> Right(P2) &nbsp; ' +
        '<span style="color:' + CHART.lineDiff + '">■</span> Diff' +
        '</p>' + modeSvg + '</div>';
    }
    return out;
  }

  function get_cached_lane_value(frm, lane_no, key) {
    if (!frm || !frm[PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY]) return "";
    const ln = parseInt(lane_no, 10);
    const c = frm[PTS3_UI_CACHE_KEY][ln] || {};
    return c[key] || "";
  }

  function render_mode_bar_chart_from_table(frm, lane) {
    // Prefer merged cache (keeps Mode1..Mode0 across multiple runs), fallback to live_table_json.
    const rawCache = get_cached_lane_value(frm, LANE_NO, "mode_values_json");
    const rawLive = lane.mode_values_json || lane.live_table_json || get_cached_lane_value(frm, LANE_NO, "live_table_json");
    const raw = rawCache || rawLive;
    if (!raw) return "";
    let t;
    try { t = typeof raw === "string" ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw; } catch (e) { return ""; }
    if (!t || typeof t !== "object") return "";

    var order = ["Mode1", "Mode2", "Mode3", "Mode0"];
    var rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      var m = t[order[i]];
      var p1 = 0, p2 = 0, df = 0;
      if (m && typeof m === "object") {
        p1 = m.p1 != null ? Number(m.p1) : 0;
        p2 = m.p2 != null ? Number(m.p2) : 0;
        df = m.diff != null ? Number(m.diff) : 0;
      }
      rows.push({ label: order[i], p1: p1, p2: p2, diff: df });
    }
    var hasAny = rows.some(function (r) { return (r.p1 || 0) !== 0 || (r.p2 || 0) !== 0 || (r.diff || 0) !== 0; });
    if (!hasAny) return "";
    return render_mode_bar_chart_svg(rows);
  }

  function render_mode_bar_chart_svg(rows) {
    // Uses same CHART dimensions; bars are grouped per mode
    var pw = CHART.width, ph = Math.max(320, Math.round(CHART.height * 0.45));
    var pad = { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 45, left: CHART.padding.left };
    var gx = pad.left, gy = pad.top, gw = pw - pad.left - pad.right, gh = ph - pad.top - pad.bottom;

    var vals = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      vals.push(rows[i].p1, rows[i].p2, rows[i].diff);
    }
    var vMin = Math.min(0, Math.min.apply(null, vals));
    var vMax = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
    if (!isFinite(vMin)) vMin = 0;
    if (!isFinite(vMax) || vMax === 0) vMax = 1;
    // add a little headroom
    var head = (vMax - vMin) * 0.1;
    vMax += head;
    vMin -= head;
    var vRange = (vMax - vMin) || 1;

    function y(v) { return gy + gh - ((Number(v) - vMin) / vRange) * gh; }
    function xGroup(i) { return gx + (i / Math.max(rows.length, 1)) * gw; }

    var svg = '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg" width="' + pw + '" height="' + ph + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + pw + ' ' + ph + '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;">';
    svg += '<g>';

    // Y grid + labels
    var ySteps = 5;
    for (var yi = 0; yi <= ySteps; yi++) {
      var yy = gy + gh - (yi / ySteps) * gh;
      var v = vMin + (yi / ySteps) * vRange;
      svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + yy + '" stroke="' + CHART.gridColor + '" stroke-width="' + (PTS3_CHART_STYLE.gridMajorWidth || 1) + '" opacity="0.6"/>';
      svg += '<text x="' + (gx - 6) + '" y="' + (yy + 4) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + format_val(v) + '</text>';
    }

    // Zero line emphasized
    if (vMin < 0 && vMax > 0) {
      var y0 = y(0);
      svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + y0 + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + y0 + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + ((PTS3_CHART_STYLE.axisWidth || 1.5) + 1) + '" opacity="0.9"/>';
    }

    // Axes
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + (PTS3_CHART_STYLE.axisWidth || 1.5) + '"/>';
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + (PTS3_CHART_STYLE.axisWidth || 1.5) + '"/>';

    // Bars + value labels
    var groupW = gw / Math.max(rows.length, 1);
    var innerPad = Math.min(18, groupW * 0.12);
    var barW = Math.max(10, (groupW - innerPad * 2) / 3.4);
    var gap = Math.max(6, barW * 0.2);
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var baseX = gx + i * groupW + innerPad;
      var yBase = y(0);
      var items = [
        { v: rows[i].p1, color: CHART.lineLeft },
        { v: rows[i].p2, color: CHART.lineRight },
        { v: rows[i].diff, color: CHART.lineDiff }
      ];
      for (var b = 0; b < items.length; b++) {
        var v = items[b].v;
        var yy = y(v);
        var top = Math.min(yy, yBase);
        var h = Math.abs(yBase - yy);
        var bx = baseX + b * (barW + gap);
        svg += '<rect x="' + bx + '" y="' + top + '" width="' + barW + '" height="' + Math.max(0.5, h) + '" fill="' + items[b].color + '" opacity="0.9" rx="6" ry="6"/>';
        // value label
        var lab = format_val(v);
        var tx = bx + barW / 2;
        var ty = top - 4;
        var anchor = "middle";
        var fill = CHART.fontColor;
        var weight = "600";
        if (ty < gy + 12) {
          ty = top + Math.min(h * 0.7, 14);
          fill = "#ffffff";
        }
        if (h < 6) {
          ty = yBase + 14;
          fill = CHART.fontColor;
        }
        svg += '<text x="' + tx + '" y="' + ty + '" text-anchor="' + anchor + '" font-size="' + (CHART.fontSize + 2) + '" font-weight="' + weight + '" fill="' + fill + '">' + lab + "</text>";
      }
      // Mode label
      svg += '<text x="' + (gx + i * groupW + groupW / 2) + '" y="' + (ph - 8) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + rows[i].label + '</text>';
    }

    svg += '</g></svg>';
    return svg;
  }

  function render_sweep_chart_svg(freqs, left, right, diff) {
    if (!freqs || freqs.length < 2) return { svg: "" };
    var L = PTS3_LIMITS.sweep || {};
    var pw = CHART.width, ph = CHART.height, pad = CHART.padding;
    var gx = pad.left, gy = pad.top, gw = pw - pad.left - pad.right, gh = ph - pad.top - pad.bottom;
    var vMin = L.yMin != null ? Number(L.yMin) : 1500;
    var vMax = L.yMax != null ? Number(L.yMax) : 3500;
    var vRange = vMax - vMin || 1;
    var freqMin = L.xMin != null ? Number(L.xMin) : 40;
    var freqMax = L.xMax != null ? Number(L.xMax) : 80;
    var freqRange = freqMax - freqMin || 1;
    function x(i) { return gx + ((Number(freqs[i]) - freqMin) / freqRange) * gw; }
    function y(v) { return gy + gh - ((Number(v) - vMin) / vRange) * gh; }
    function path(arr) {
      var pts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        if (arr[i] != null && !isNaN(Number(arr[i]))) pts.push(x(i) + "," + y(arr[i]));
      }
      return pts.length ? "M" + pts.join(" L") : "";
    }
    var pLeft = path(left), pRight = path(right), pDiff = path(diff);
    var S = PTS3_CHART_STYLE;
    var xMajor = S.xMajorInterval > 0 ? S.xMajorInterval : 6;
    var xMinor = S.xMinorInterval > 0 ? S.xMinorInterval : 2;
    var yMaj = S.yMajorCount > 0 ? S.yMajorCount : 5;
    var yMinPer = S.yMinorPerMajor > 0 ? S.yMinorPerMajor : 4;
    var gMajW = S.gridMajorWidth != null ? S.gridMajorWidth : 1;
    var gMinW = S.gridMinorWidth != null ? S.gridMinorWidth : 0.5;
    var gMinOp = S.gridMinorOpacity != null ? S.gridMinorOpacity : 0.8;
    var axW = S.axisWidth != null ? S.axisWidth : 6;
    var lw = S.lineWidth != null ? S.lineWidth : 4;
    var dlw = S.diffLineWidth != null ? S.diffLineWidth : lw;
    var svg = '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg" width="' + pw + '" height="' + ph + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + pw + ' ' + ph + '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;">';
    svg += '<g>';
    for (var tickFreq = freqMin; tickFreq <= freqMax; tickFreq += xMinor) {
      var xx = gx + ((Number(tickFreq) - freqMin) / freqRange) * gw;
      if (xx >= gx - 1 && xx <= gx + gw + 1) {
        var isMajor = (tickFreq - freqMin) % xMajor === 0;
        svg += '<line x1="' + xx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + xx + '" y2="' + gy + '" stroke="' + CHART.gridColor + '" stroke-width="' + (isMajor ? gMajW : gMinW) + '" opacity="' + (isMajor ? 0.5 : gMinOp) + '"/>';
        if (isMajor) svg += '<text x="' + xx + '" y="' + (ph - 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + tickFreq + '</text>';
      }
    }
    var stepY = 250;
    var startY = Math.ceil(vMin / stepY) * stepY;
    var endY = Math.floor(vMax / stepY) * stepY;
    for (var v = startY; v <= endY; v += stepY) {
      var yy = y(v);
      var isZero = Number(v) === 0;
      svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + yy + '" stroke="' + (isZero ? CHART.axisColor : CHART.gridColor) + '" stroke-width="' + (isZero ? (axW + 1) : gMajW) + '" opacity="' + (isZero ? 0.95 : 0.8) + '"/>';
      svg += '<text x="' + (gx - 6) + '" y="' + (yy + 3) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + format_val(v) + '</text>';
    }
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + axW + '"/>';
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + axW + '"/>';
    if (pLeft) svg += '<path d="' + pLeft + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineLeft + '" stroke-width="' + lw + '"/>';
    if (pRight) svg += '<path d="' + pRight + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineRight + '" stroke-width="' + lw + '"/>';
    if (pDiff) svg += '<path d="' + pDiff + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineDiff + '" stroke-width="' + dlw + '" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>';
    svg += '</g></svg>';
    return { svg: svg };
  }

  function render_diff_chart_svg(freqs, diff) {
    if (!freqs || freqs.length < 2 || !diff || diff.length < 2) return "";
    var L = PTS3_LIMITS.diff || {};
    var pw = CHART.width, ph = CHART.height, pad = CHART.padding;
    var gx = pad.left, gy = pad.top, gw = pw - pad.left - pad.right, gh = ph - pad.top - pad.bottom;
    var vMin = L.yMin != null ? Number(L.yMin) : -160;
    var vMax = L.yMax != null ? Number(L.yMax) : 160;
    var vRange = vMax - vMin || 1;
    var freqMin = L.xMin != null ? Number(L.xMin) : 40;
    var freqMax = L.xMax != null ? Number(L.xMax) : 80;
    var freqRange = freqMax - freqMin || 1;
    function x(i) { var f = Number(freqs[i]) || freqMin; return gx + ((f - freqMin) / freqRange) * gw; }
    function y(v) { return gy + gh - ((Number(v) - vMin) / vRange) * gh; }
    function path(arr) {
      var pts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        if (arr[i] != null && !isNaN(Number(arr[i]))) pts.push(x(i) + "," + y(arr[i]));
      }
      return pts.length ? "M" + pts.join(" L") : "";
    }
    var pDiff = path(diff);
    if (!pDiff) return "";
    var S = PTS3_CHART_STYLE;
    var xMajor = S.xMajorInterval > 0 ? S.xMajorInterval : 4;
    var xMinor = S.xMinorInterval > 0 ? S.xMinorInterval : 2;
    var yMaj = S.yMajorCount > 0 ? S.yMajorCount : 5;
    var yMinPer = S.yMinorPerMajor > 0 ? S.yMinorPerMajor : 2;
    var gMajW = S.gridMajorWidth != null ? S.gridMajorWidth : 1;
    var gMinW = S.gridMinorWidth != null ? S.gridMinorWidth : 0.5;
    var gMinOp = S.gridMinorOpacity != null ? S.gridMinorOpacity : 0.3;
    var axW = S.axisWidth != null ? S.axisWidth : 1.5;
    var dlw = S.diffLineWidth != null ? S.diffLineWidth : (S.lineWidth != null ? S.lineWidth : 2);
    var svg = '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg" width="' + pw + '" height="' + ph + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + pw + ' ' + ph + '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;">';
    svg += '<g>';
    for (var tickFreq = freqMin; tickFreq <= freqMax; tickFreq += xMinor) {
      var xx = gx + ((Number(tickFreq) - freqMin) / freqRange) * gw;
      if (xx >= gx - 1 && xx <= gx + gw + 1) {
        var isMajor = (tickFreq - freqMin) % xMajor === 0;
        svg += '<line x1="' + xx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + xx + '" y2="' + gy + '" stroke="' + CHART.gridColor + '" stroke-width="' + (isMajor ? gMajW : gMinW) + '" opacity="' + (isMajor ? 0.5 : gMinOp) + '"/>';
        if (isMajor) svg += '<text x="' + xx + '" y="' + (ph - 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + tickFreq + '</text>';
      }
    }
    var stepY = 40;
    var startY = Math.ceil(vMin / stepY) * stepY;
    var endY = Math.floor(vMax / stepY) * stepY;
    for (var v = startY; v <= endY; v += stepY) {
      var yy = y(v);
      var isZero = Number(v) === 0;
      svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + yy + '" stroke="' + (isZero ? CHART.axisColor : CHART.gridColor) + '" stroke-width="' + (isZero ? (axW + 1) : gMajW) + '" opacity="' + (isZero ? 0.95 : 0.8) + '"/>';
      svg += '<text x="' + (gx - 6) + '" y="' + (yy + 3) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' + CHART.fontSize + '" fill="' + CHART.fontColor + '">' + format_val(v) + '</text>';
    }
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + axW + '"/>';
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + CHART.axisColor + '" stroke-width="' + axW + '"/>';
    svg += '<path d="' + pDiff + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineDiff + '" stroke-width="' + dlw + '" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>';
    svg += '</g></svg>';
    return svg;
  }

})();

//PTS3 result client script 
// ============================================================
// PTS3 Result - Client Script (Visual Inspection)
// DocType: PTS3 Result
// Renders: Summary, Step Sweep (chart + table), Mode (chart + table), Left/Right/Diff, Artifacts
// Uses final_graph_json, mode_values_json, left_right_diff_summary_json, artifact_paths
// ============================================================

(function () {
  /** F12 console: filter by [PTS3] */
  function pts3Dbg() {
    try {
      if (typeof console !== "undefined" && console.info) {
        var a = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments);
        console.info.apply(console, ["[PTS3]"].concat(a));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Chart styling - theme-aware (light/dark mode compatible)
  var CHART = {
    width: 1000,
    height: 500,
    padding: { top: 20, right: 20, bottom: 40, left: 102 },
    fontSize: 10,        // Axis and label font size (e.g. 8, 10, 12)
    lineLeft: "#E53935",   // Red for Left
    lineRight: "#2196F3",  // Blue for Right
    lineDiff: "#4CAF50",   // Green for Diff
    barP1: "#E53935",      // Red for P1 (Left)
    barP2: "#2196F3",      // Blue for P2 (Right)
    barDiff: "#4CAF50",    // Green for Diff
    axisColor: "var(--text-muted, #6c7680)",
    gridColor: "var(--border-color, #d1d8dd)"
  };

  /**
   * Step Sweep + Diff vs Hz share font, grid/axis widths, tick size, xTickHz.
   * yTickStep: Diff vs Hz Y grid step. yTickStepSweep: Step Sweep Y grid step (e.g. 250).
   * yAxisTitleSweep / yAxisTitleDiff: Y-axis label ("" to hide).
   * gridOpacity / gridStrokeWidth: major grid lines (both Step Sweep + Diff vs Hz).
   * yAxisTitleGapPx: horizontal space from plot Y-axis to rotated title (larger = title further left).
   */
  var PTS3_SHARED_AXIS = {
    fontSize: 20,
    yAxisTitleGapPx: 75,
    gridStrokeWidth: 2,
    gridOpacity: 1,
    axisStrokeWidth: 1,
    tickLength: 4,
    xTickHz: 2,
    yTickStep: 40,
    yTickStepSweep: 250,
    maxYTicks: 16,
    yAxisTitleSweep: "Voltage in mV",
    yAxisTitleDiff: "Difference"
  };

  // Step Sweep Y-axis: both yMin and yMax set => fixed range (Left/Right scale; Diff is clipped in plot).
  // One or both null => auto from Left+Right only (Diff does not shrink the axis).
  var SWEEP_CHART = {
    yMin: 1500,
    yMax: 4000,
    lineWidth: 2,
    diffLineWidth: 1.5,
    fontSize: null
  };

  // Mode bar chart + Diff vs frequency (Hz) line chart share these Y limits when set.
  // Both yMin and yMax set => fixed axis for those charts (no auto expand). One or both null => auto from data where needed.
  var MODE_CHART = {
    yMin: -120,
    yMax: 120,
    fontSize: null
  };

  /**
   * Mode Results chart. verticalCandles: true (default) = grouped vertical columns (L/R/Diff) per mode with value labels.
   * Set false for legacy horizontal bars. Does not affect Diff vs Hz.
   */
  var MODE_HBAR = {
    valueMin: 0,
    valueMax: 3500,
    tickStep: 250,
    useAutoValueRange: true,
    compactAxisFloor: 140,
    compactTickStep: 20,
    barCornerRadius: 10,
    /** Horizontal bar chart only: draw numbers on bars. */
    showBarValueLabels: false,
    /** Vertical candle chart: show numeric value on/near each column (default true). */
    showCandleValueLabels: true,
    verticalCandles: true,
    verticalPlotHeight: 340,
    /** Horizontal gap between Mode1 / Mode2 / … groups (px). Lower = clusters closer. */
    candleGroupGap: 2,
    /** Vertical candles: pack each group to bar cluster width (not full 1/N of plot). Reduces empty space when candleWidthScale is below 1. Set false for equal-width slots. */
    candlePackGroups: true,
    /** Extra horizontal padding (px) on each side of a cluster when packing (mode label stays centered on slot). */
    candleClusterSidePad: 20,
    /** When packed: "left" = bar groups flush to plot inner left; "center" = row centered in plot. */
    candlePackHAlign: "left",
    /** Gap between Left / Right / Diff bars inside one group; null = use innerGap. */
    candleInnerGap: null,
    /** Multiplier on bar width after layout (then clamped to fit the group slot). */
    candleWidthScale: 0.7,
    /** Font (px) on Y-axis tick numbers. null = auto from MODE_CHART / sweep axis. */
    candleAxisTickFontPx: 20,
    /** Font (px) on numbers drawn on/near each candle. null = slightly below axis ticks. */
    candleValueFontPx: 25,
    /** Font (px) for top “Value” and bottom “Mode” titles. null = auto. */
    candleTitleFontPx: 25,
    /** Font (px) for Mode1… labels under each group. null = same as axis ticks. */
    candleModeLabelFontPx: 25,
    plotWidth: 1280,
    rowBand: 78,
    innerGap: 4,
    labelColW: 108,
    xTickFontShrink: 5,
    /** Left / Right / Difference row only (px). Set null to match chart axis font (pts3_axis_font / MODE_CHART.fontSize). */
    legendFontPx: 12
  };

  /** Sans stack for mode SVG text (matches legend; single-quoted names safe inside style="..."). */
  var PTS3_SANS_FONT_STACK_CSS = "system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif";

  // Key/Left/Right/Diff vertical table from left_right_diff_summary_json (duplicate of Step Sweep channel table).
  // Set true to show it again under result_inspection HTML.
  var SHOW_LEFT_RIGHT_DIFF_SUMMARY_SECTION = false;

  // Match Desk user menu "Toggle Full Width" (uses localStorage + body.full-width). Set false to leave desk width unchanged.
  var PTS3_ENABLE_DESK_FULL_WIDTH_ON_LOAD = true;

  /** Summary panel only (left column). Set null to use theme default for heading / table. */
  var PTS3_SUMMARY_FONTS = {
    headingRem: 1.05,
    tablePx: 13
  };

  var HTML2CANVAS_CDN = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js";
  var INSPECTION_PNG_SCALE = 2.5;

  if (document.getElementById("pts3-result-style-v16") == null) {
    ["pts3-result-style", "pts3-result-style-v4", "pts3-result-style-v5", "pts3-result-style-v6", "pts3-result-style-v7", "pts3-result-style-v8", "pts3-result-style-v9", "pts3-result-style-v10", "pts3-result-style-v11", "pts3-result-style-v12", "pts3-result-style-v13", "pts3-result-style-v14", "pts3-result-style-v15"].forEach(function (rid) {
      var old = document.getElementById(rid);
      if (old && old.parentNode) {
        old.parentNode.removeChild(old);
      }
    });
    var style = document.createElement("style");
    style.id = "pts3-result-style-v16";
    var sumH = PTS3_SUMMARY_FONTS.headingRem;
    var sumT = PTS3_SUMMARY_FONTS.tablePx;
    var sumCss = "";
    if (sumH != null && isFinite(Number(sumH))) {
      sumCss += ".pts3-summary-section h4{font-size:" + Number(sumH) + "rem!important;}";
    }
    if (sumT != null && isFinite(Number(sumT))) {
      sumCss += ".pts3-summary-section .pts3-result-table{font-size:" + Number(sumT) + "px!important;}";
    }
    style.textContent =
      ".pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap,.pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap .control-input-wrapper,.pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap .control-value,.pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap .like-disabled-input{min-width:0!important;max-width:100%!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;}.pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}.pts3-step-sweep-hscroll{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:visible;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-gutter:stable;}.pts3-sweep-table-scroll{width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;margin:0.5rem 6fr;gap:1rem;align-items:stretch;width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;}.pts3-summary-mode-row>.pts3-result-section{min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;}.pts3-summary-mode-row .pts3-mode-chart{min-width:0;flex:1 1 auto;}@media (max-width:992px){.pts3-summary-mode-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}.pts3-result-section{margin:1rem 0;padding:0.75rem;border:1px solid solid var(--border-color,#d1d8dd);}.pts3-mode-under-step{margin-top:1rem;padding-top:0.85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color,#e2e8f0);}.pts3-mode-under-step-title{margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:0.95rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-color,#36414c);}.pts3-mode-step-table{font-size:calc(0.9em - 1px);}.pts3-mode-step-table thead th{background:#f8f9fa!important;font-weight:700;color:#212529;border:1px solid #dee2e6!important;padding:8px 10px;}.pts3-mode-step-table tbody td{border:1px solid #dee2e6!important;padding:8px 10px;background:#fff;color:#212529;}.pts3-mode-step-table tbody td.pts3-mode-step-name{color:#1976d2;font-weight:500;}" +
      sumCss;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  /** Accepts JSON string or already-parsed object (some Frappe/API paths deserialize Code fields). */
  function safe_json(val, fallback) {
    var hasFallback = arguments.length >= 2;
    if (val == null || val === "") return hasFallback ? fallback : {};
    if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null && !Array.isArray(val)) {
      return val;
    }
    if (typeof val === "string") {
      try {
        var o = JSON.parse(val);
        return o && typeof o === "object" && !Array.isArray(o) ? o : (hasFallback ? fallback : {});
      } catch (e) {
        return hasFallback ? fallback : {};
      }
    }
    return hasFallback ? fallback : {};
  }

  function escape_html(s) {
    if (s == null || s === undefined) return "";
    var t = String(s);
    return t.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function render_summary(frm) {
    var d = frm.doc;
    var html = '<div class="pts3-result-section pts3-summary-section"><h4>Summary</h4><table class="pts3-result-table"><tbody>';
    html += "<tr><th>PCB Serial No</th><td>" + escape_html(d.pcb_serial_no || "") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "<tr><th>Run ID</th><td>" + escape_html(d.run_id || "") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "<tr><th>Operation</th><td>" + escape_html(d.operation || "") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "<tr><th>Datetime</th><td>" + escape_html(d.datetime || "") + "</td></tr>";
    var pf = (d.pass_fail || "").trim();
    var pfClass = pf === "Pass" ? "pts3-result-pass" : pf === "Fail" ? "pts3-result-fail" : "";
    html += "<tr><th>Pass/Fail</th><td class=\"" + pfClass + "\">" + escape_html(pf || "-") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "<tr><th>Dominant Channel</th><td>" + escape_html(d.dominant_channel || "") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "<tr><th>Max Value</th><td>" + escape_html(d.max_value != null ? d.max_value : "") + "</td></tr>";
    html += "</tbody></table></div>";
    return html;
  }

  function format_num(v) {
    if (v == null || isNaN(v)) return "";
    var n = Number(v);
    return n % 1 === 0 ? String(n) : n.toFixed(2);
  }

  /** HTML tables: green Difference/Diff cell when |value| <= this (edit to change tolerance). */
  var PTS3_DIFF_OK_ABS_MAX = 40;

  function pts3_is_diff_within_tolerance(v) {
    if (v == null || v === "") return false;
    var n = Number(v);
    if (isNaN(n)) return false;
    return Math.abs(n) <= PTS3_DIFF_OK_ABS_MAX;
  }

  function pts3_diff_td_open(v) {
    return pts3_is_diff_within_tolerance(v) ? '<td class="pts3-diff-ok">' : "<td>";
  }

  function pts3_axis_font() {
    if (SWEEP_CHART.fontSize != null) {
      return SWEEP_CHART.fontSize;
    }
    return PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.fontSize != null ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.fontSize : (CHART.fontSize || 10);
  }

  function pts3_x_tick_hz() {
    return PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.xTickHz > 0 ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.xTickHz : 2;
  }

  function pts3_y_step_for_range(vMin, vMax, baseStep) {
    var step;
    if (baseStep != null && baseStep > 0) {
      step = baseStep;
    } else {
      step = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yTickStep > 0 ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yTickStep : 40;
    }
    var span = Math.max(vMax - vMin, 1e-9);
    var maxT = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.maxYTicks > 0 ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.maxYTicks : 16;
    while (span / step > maxT) {
      step *= 2;
    }
    return step;
  }

  function pts3_snap_bounds(vMin, vMax, step) {
    var lo = Math.floor(vMin / step) * step;
    var hi = Math.ceil(vMax / step) * step;
    if (hi <= lo) {
      hi = lo + step;
    }
    return { min: lo, max: hi };
  }

  function pts3_grid_line_style(gridClr) {
    var gsw = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.gridStrokeWidth > 0 ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.gridStrokeWidth : 1;
    var go = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.gridOpacity != null ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.gridOpacity : 0.72;
    return (
      ' stroke="' +
      gridClr +
      '" stroke-width="' +
      gsw +
      '" stroke-opacity="' +
      go +
      '" shape-rendering="crispEdges"'
    );
  }

  function pts3_append_x_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, labelY, freqMin, freqMax, axisClr, gridClr, fs) {
    var freqRange = freqMax - freqMin || 1;
    var xHz = pts3_x_tick_hz();
    var tickLen = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.tickLength;
    var asw = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.axisStrokeWidth;
    function xFromFreq(f) {
      return gx + ((Number(f) - freqMin) / freqRange) * gw;
    }
    for (var tickFreq = freqMin; tickFreq <= freqMax + 1e-9; tickFreq += xHz) {
      var xx = xFromFreq(tickFreq);
      if (xx < gx - 1 || xx > gx + gw + 1) {
        continue;
      }
      svg += '<line x1="' + xx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + xx + '" y2="' + gy + '"' + pts3_grid_line_style(gridClr) + "/>";
      if (tickFreq > freqMin && tickFreq < freqMax) {
        svg += '<line x1="' + xx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + xx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh + tickLen) + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';
      }
      svg += '<text x="' + xx + '" y="' + labelY + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + fs + '" fill="' + axisClr + '">' + tickFreq + "</text>";
    }
    return svg;
  }

  function pts3_append_y_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, vMin, vMax, yStep, axisClr, gridClr, fs) {
    var vRange = vMax - vMin || 1;
    var tickLen = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.tickLength;
    var asw = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.axisStrokeWidth;
    var startTick = Math.floor(vMin / yStep + 1e-12) * yStep;
    for (var tv = startTick; tv <= vMax + 1e-9; tv += yStep) {
      if (tv < vMin - 1e-9) {
        continue;
      }
      var yy = gy + gh - ((tv - vMin) / vRange) * gh;
      svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + yy + '"' + pts3_grid_line_style(gridClr) + "/>";
      svg += '<line x1="' + (gx - tickLen) + '" y1="' + yy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + yy + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';
      svg += '<text x="' + (gx - 6) + '" y="' + (yy + 3) + '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' + fs + '" fill="' + axisClr + '">' + format_num(tv) + "</text>";
    }
    return svg;
  }

  function pts3_append_y_axis_title(svg, titleText, gx, gy, gh, axisClr, fs) {
    if (titleText == null || String(titleText).trim() === "") {
      return svg;
    }
    var mid = gy + gh / 2;
    var titleGap = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yAxisTitleGapPx != null ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yAxisTitleGapPx : 96;
    var lx = Math.max(12, gx - titleGap);
    svg +=
      '<text transform="translate(' +
      lx +
      "," +
      mid +
      ') rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-size="' +
      fs +
      '" fill="' +
      axisClr +
      '">' +
      escape_html(String(titleText).trim()) +
      "</text>";
    return svg;
  }

  function render_sweep_chart_svg(freqs, left, right, diff) {
    if (!freqs || freqs.length < 2) return { svg: "", coords: null };
    var pw = CHART.width;
    var ph = CHART.height;
    var pad = CHART.padding;
    var gx = pad.left;
    var gy = pad.top;
    var gw = pw - pad.left - pad.right;
    var gh = ph - pad.top - pad.bottom;
    var axisClr = CHART.axisColor;
    var gridClr = CHART.gridColor;
    var fs = pts3_axis_font();
    var asw = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.axisStrokeWidth;

    var lrVals = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < left.length; i++) {
      if (left[i] != null) lrVals.push(Number(left[i]));
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < right.length; j++) {
      if (right[j] != null) lrVals.push(Number(right[j]));
    }
    var lrMin = lrVals.length ? Math.min.apply(null, lrVals) : 0;
    var lrMax = lrVals.length ? Math.max.apply(null, lrVals) : 1;
    var yminC = SWEEP_CHART.yMin;
    var ymaxC = SWEEP_CHART.yMax;
    var vMin;
    var vMax;
    var sweepSnap;
    if (yminC != null && ymaxC != null) {
      vMin = Number(yminC);
      vMax = Number(ymaxC);
      sweepSnap = false;
    } else if (yminC == null && ymaxC == null) {
      vMin = lrMin;
      vMax = lrMax;
      sweepSnap = true;
    } else if (yminC != null) {
      vMin = Number(yminC);
      vMax = ymaxC != null ? Number(ymaxC) : lrMax;
      if (ymaxC == null) {
        vMax = Math.max(vMax, lrMax);
      }
      sweepSnap = true;
    } else {
      vMin = lrMin;
      vMax = Number(ymaxC);
      vMax = Math.max(vMax, lrMax);
      sweepSnap = true;
    }
    var sweepStepBase = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yTickStepSweep > 0 ? PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yTickStepSweep : PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yTickStep;
    var yStep = pts3_y_step_for_range(vMin, vMax, sweepStepBase);
    if (sweepSnap) {
      var snapped = pts3_snap_bounds(vMin, vMax, yStep);
      vMin = snapped.min;
      vMax = snapped.max;
    }
    var vRange = vMax - vMin || 1;

    function x(i) {
      return gx + (i / Math.max(freqs.length - 1, 1)) * gw;
    }
    function y(v) {
      return gy + gh - ((Number(v) - vMin) / vRange) * gh;
    }

    function path(arr) {
      var pts = [];
      for (var ii = 0; ii < arr.length; ii++) {
        if (arr[ii] != null && !isNaN(Number(arr[ii]))) {
          pts.push(x(ii) + "," + y(arr[ii]));
        }
      }
      return pts.length ? "M" + pts.join(" L") : "";
    }

    var pLeft = path(left);
    var pRight = path(right);
    var pDiff = path(diff);

    var freqMin = Number(freqs[0]) || 0;
    var freqMax = Number(freqs[freqs.length - 1]) || 1;
    var freqRange = freqMax - freqMin || 1;

    var clipId = "pts3_sw_" + String(Date.now()) + "_" + String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9));
    var svg =
      '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg" viewBox="0 0 ' +
      pw +
      " " +
      ph +
      '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;vertical-align:top;">' +
      "<defs><clipPath id=\"" +
      clipId +
      '"><rect x="' +
      gx +
      '" y="' +
      gy +
      '" width="' +
      gw +
      '" height="' +
      gh +
      '"/></clipPath></defs><g>';
    svg = pts3_append_x_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, ph - 2, freqMin, freqMax, axisClr, gridClr, fs);
    svg = pts3_append_y_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, vMin, vMax, yStep, axisClr, gridClr, fs);
    svg = pts3_append_y_axis_title(svg, PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yAxisTitleSweep, gx, gy, gh, axisClr, fs);
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';
    var lw = SWEEP_CHART.lineWidth > 0 ? SWEEP_CHART.lineWidth : 2;
    var dlw = SWEEP_CHART.diffLineWidth != null ? SWEEP_CHART.diffLineWidth : lw;
    svg += '<g clip-path="url(#' + clipId + ')">';
    if (pLeft) svg += '<path d="' + pLeft + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineLeft + '" stroke-width="' + lw + '"/>';
    if (pRight) svg += '<path d="' + pRight + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineRight + '" stroke-width="' + lw + '"/>';
    if (pDiff) svg += '<path d="' + pDiff + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineDiff + '" stroke-width="' + dlw + '" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>';
    svg += "</g></g></svg>";
    var coords = { freqMin: freqMin, freqMax: freqMax, freqRange: freqRange, vMin: vMin, vMax: vMax, vRange: vRange, gx: gx, gy: gy, gw: gw, gh: gh, pw: pw, ph: ph };
    return { svg: svg, coords: coords };
  }

  /** Line chart: Diff (Y) vs index-aligned Hz (X). Y-scale uses diff values only. */
  function render_diff_vs_hz_svg(freqs, diff) {
    if (!freqs || freqs.length < 2 || !diff || diff.length < 2) {
      return "";
    }
    var diffs = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < diff.length; i++) {
      if (diff[i] != null && !isNaN(Number(diff[i]))) {
        diffs.push(Number(diff[i]));
      }
    }
    if (diffs.length < 2) {
      return "";
    }

    var pw = CHART.width;
    var ph = CHART.height;
    var pad = CHART.padding;
    var gx = pad.left;
    var gy = pad.top;
    var gw = pw - pad.left - pad.right;
    var gh = ph - pad.top - pad.bottom;
    var axisClr = CHART.axisColor;
    var gridClr = CHART.gridColor;
    var fs = pts3_axis_font();
    var asw = PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.axisStrokeWidth;

    var rawMin = Math.min.apply(null, diffs);
    var rawMax = Math.max.apply(null, diffs);
    var span = rawMax - rawMin;
    var padY = span > 0 ? span * 0.1 : Math.max(Math.abs(rawMin), Math.abs(rawMax), 1) * 0.1;
    var dymin = MODE_CHART.yMin;
    var dymax = MODE_CHART.yMax;
    var vMin;
    var vMax;
    var diffSnap;
    if (dymin != null && dymax != null) {
      vMin = Number(dymin);
      vMax = Number(dymax);
      diffSnap = false;
    } else if (dymin == null && dymax == null) {
      vMin = rawMin - padY;
      vMax = rawMax + padY;
      if (vMin === vMax) {
        vMin -= 1;
        vMax += 1;
      }
      diffSnap = true;
    } else if (dymin != null) {
      vMin = Number(dymin);
      vMax = dymax != null ? Number(dymax) : rawMax + padY;
      if (dymax == null) {
        vMax = Math.max(vMax, rawMax + padY);
      }
      diffSnap = true;
    } else {
      vMax = Math.max(Number(dymax), rawMax + padY);
      vMin = rawMin - padY;
      if (vMin >= vMax) {
        vMin = vMax - 1;
      }
      diffSnap = true;
    }
    var yStep = pts3_y_step_for_range(vMin, vMax);
    if (diffSnap) {
      var snappedD = pts3_snap_bounds(vMin, vMax, yStep);
      vMin = snappedD.min;
      vMax = snappedD.max;
    }
    var vRange = vMax - vMin || 1;

    var freqMin = Number(freqs[0]) || 0;
    var freqMax = Number(freqs[freqs.length - 1]) || 1;

    function x(i) {
      return gx + (i / Math.max(freqs.length - 1, 1)) * gw;
    }
    function y(v) {
      return gy + gh - ((Number(v) - vMin) / vRange) * gh;
    }

    var pts = [];
    for (var pi = 0; pi < diff.length; pi++) {
      if (diff[pi] != null && !isNaN(Number(diff[pi]))) {
        pts.push(x(pi) + "," + y(diff[pi]));
      }
    }
    var pathD = pts.length ? "M" + pts.join(" L") : "";

    var svg =
      '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg pts3-diff-hz-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' +
      pw +
      " " +
      ph +
      '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;vertical-align:top;"><g>';
    svg = pts3_append_x_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, ph - 2, freqMin, freqMax, axisClr, gridClr, fs);
    svg = pts3_append_y_grid(svg, gx, gy, gw, gh, vMin, vMax, yStep, axisClr, gridClr, fs);
    svg = pts3_append_y_axis_title(svg, PTS3_SHARED_AXIS.yAxisTitleDiff, gx, gy, gh, axisClr, fs);

    if (vMin <= 0 && vMax >= 0) {
      var y0 = y(0);
      if (y0 >= gy && y0 <= gy + gh) {
        svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + y0 + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + y0 + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '" stroke-dasharray="3,3" opacity="0.7"/>';
      }
    }

    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + (gy + gh) + '" x2="' + (gx + gw) + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';
    svg += '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (gy + gh) + '" stroke="' + axisClr + '" stroke-width="' + asw + '"/>';

    var lw = SWEEP_CHART.lineWidth > 0 ? SWEEP_CHART.lineWidth : 2;
    if (pathD) {
      svg += '<path d="' + pathD + '" fill="none" stroke="' + CHART.lineDiff + '" stroke-width="' + lw + '"/>';
    }

    svg += "</g></svg>";
    return svg;
  }

  function build_sweep_from_lrd(t) {
    if (!t || typeof t !== "object") return null;
    var left = t.left || {};
    var right = t.right || {};
    var diff = t.diff || {};
    var keys = Object.keys(left).concat(Object.keys(right)).concat(Object.keys(diff));
    keys = keys.filter(function (k, i, a) { return a.indexOf(k) === i; }).sort(function (a, b) {
      var na = parseInt(String(a).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10) || 0;
      var nb = parseInt(String(b).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10) || 0;
      return na - nb;
    });
    if (keys.length < 2) return null;
    var freqs = [];
    var leftArr = [];
    var rightArr = [];
    var diffArr = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var k = keys[i];
      var hz = parseInt(String(k).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10);
      if (!isNaN(hz)) {
        freqs.push(hz);
        leftArr.push(left[k] != null ? left[k] : null);
        rightArr.push(right[k] != null ? right[k] : null);
        diffArr.push(diff[k] != null ? diff[k] : null);
      }
    }
    return freqs.length >= 2 ? { freqs: freqs, left: leftArr, right: rightArr, diff: diffArr } : null;
  }

  function render_step_sweep(frm) {
    var g = safe_json(frm.doc.final_graph_json, null);
    var isSweep = g && (g.type === "sweep" || g.type === "step_sweep") && (g.freqs || []).length >= 2;
    if (!isSweep) {
      var lrd = safe_json(frm.doc.left_right_diff_summary_json, null);
      g = build_sweep_from_lrd(lrd);
    }
    if (!g || !g.freqs || g.freqs.length < 2) {
      return '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Step Sweep</h4><p class="pts3-result-no-data">No sweep data</p></div>';
    }
    var freqs = g.freqs || [];
    var left = g.left || [];
    var right = g.right || [];
    var diff = g.diff || [];
    var html = '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Step Sweep</h4><div class="pts3-step-sweep-hscroll">';
    if (freqs.length >= 2) {
      var sweepFs = pts3_axis_font();
      var sweepAxis = CHART.axisColor;
      var chartResult = render_sweep_chart_svg(freqs, left, right, diff);
      var sweepData = JSON.stringify({ freqs: freqs, left: left, right: right, diff: diff, coords: chartResult.coords });
      var diffHzSvg = render_diff_vs_hz_svg(freqs, diff);
      var sweepLegend = '<p style="font-size:' + sweepFs + 'px;margin:0 0 4px 0;"><span style="color:' + CHART.lineLeft + '">—</span> Left &nbsp; <span style="color:' + CHART.lineRight + '">—</span> Right &nbsp; <span style="color:' + CHART.lineDiff + '">- -</span> Diff</p>';
      var sweepBlock = sweepLegend + '<div class="pts3-sweep-chart-container" data-sweep="' + escape_html(sweepData) + '"><div class="pts3-sweep-tooltip" id="pts3-sweep-tooltip"></div>' + chartResult.svg + "</div>";
      if (diffHzSvg) {
        html += '<div class="pts3-sweep-diff-row">';
        html += '<div class="pts3-sweep-diff-col"><div class="pts3-chart-wrap">' + sweepBlock + "</div></div>";
        html += '<div class="pts3-sweep-diff-col"><div class="pts3-chart-wrap pts3-diff-hz-wrap"><p style="font-size:' + sweepFs + 'px;margin:0 0 4px 0;color:' + sweepAxis + ';">Diff vs frequency (Hz)</p>' + diffHzSvg + "</div></div>";
        html += "</div>";
      } else {
        html += '<div class="pts3-chart-wrap">' + sweepBlock + "</div>";
      }
    }
    var modeOrder = ["Mode1", "Mode2", "Mode3", "Mode0"];
    var mMode = safe_json(frm.doc.mode_values_json, null);

    function mode_cell_for_row(modeKey, channel) {
      if (!mMode || typeof mMode !== "object") {
        return "<td></td>";
      }
      var v = get_mode_value(mMode, modeKey);
      if (!v || typeof v !== "object") {
        return "<td></td>";
      }
      var num = channel === "left" ? v.p1 : channel === "right" ? v.p2 : v.diff;
      if (num == null) {
        return "<td></td>";
      }
      if (channel === "diff") {
        return pts3_diff_td_open(num) + escape_html(format_num(num)) + "</td>";
      }
      return "<td>" + escape_html(format_num(num)) + "</td>";
    }

    html += '<div class="pts3-sweep-table-scroll"><table class="pts3-result-table pts3-sweep-mode-unified"><thead><tr><th>Channel</th>';
    for (var h = 0; h < freqs.length; h++) {
      html += '<th>' + escape_html(freqs[h]) + 'hz</th>';
    }
    html += '<th class="pts3-table-gap-col">_</th>';
    for (var mh = 0; mh < modeOrder.length; mh++) {
      html += "<th>" + escape_html(modeOrder[mh]) + "</th>";
    }
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    html += '<tr><td>Left</td>';
    for (var a = 0; a < freqs.length; a++) {
      html += '<td>' + escape_html(format_num(left[a])) + '</td>';
    }
    html += '<td class="pts3-table-gap-col"></td>';
    for (var ma = 0; ma < modeOrder.length; ma++) {
      html += mode_cell_for_row(modeOrder[ma], "left");
    }
    html += '</tr><tr><td>Right</td>';
    for (var b = 0; b < freqs.length; b++) {
      html += '<td>' + escape_html(format_num(right[b])) + '</td>';
    }
    html += '<td class="pts3-table-gap-col"></td>';
    for (var mb = 0; mb < modeOrder.length; mb++) {
      html += mode_cell_for_row(modeOrder[mb], "right");
    }
    html += '</tr><tr><td>Diff</td>';
    for (var c = 0; c < freqs.length; c++) {
      html += pts3_diff_td_open(diff[c]) + escape_html(format_num(diff[c])) + "</td>";
    }
    html += '<td class="pts3-table-gap-col"></td>';
    for (var mc = 0; mc < modeOrder.length; mc++) {
      html += mode_cell_for_row(modeOrder[mc], "diff");
    }
    html += '</tr></tbody></table></div>';
    html += "</div></div>";
    return html;
  }

  function get_mode_value(m, key) {
    if (m[key]) return m[key];
    var lower = key.toLowerCase();
    if (m[lower]) return m[lower];
    return null;
  }

  function compute_mode_hbar_axis(rows) {
    var dataMin = Infinity;
    var dataMax = -Infinity;
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      dataMin = Math.min(dataMin, rows[i].left, rows[i].right, rows[i].diff);
      dataMax = Math.max(dataMax, rows[i].left, rows[i].right, rows[i].diff);
    }
    var floorTop = MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor : 140;
    var stepSmall = MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep : 20;
    var stepLarge = MODE_HBAR.tickStep > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.tickStep : 250;
    if (!isFinite(dataMin) || !isFinite(dataMax)) {
      return { minVal: 0, maxVal: floorTop, tickStep: stepSmall };
    }
    var useAuto = MODE_HBAR.useAutoValueRange !== false;
    if (!useAuto) {
      var mn = MODE_HBAR.valueMin != null ? Number(MODE_HBAR.valueMin) : 0;
      var mx = MODE_HBAR.valueMax != null ? Number(MODE_HBAR.valueMax) : 3500;
      var ts = stepLarge;
      if (!isFinite(mn) || !isFinite(mx) || mn >= mx) {
        mn = 0;
        mx = 3500;
      }
      return { minVal: mn, maxVal: mx, tickStep: ts };
    }
    if (dataMax <= 300 && dataMin >= 0) {
      var maxVal = Math.max(floorTop, Math.ceil((dataMax * 1.06) / stepSmall) * stepSmall);
      return { minVal: 0, maxVal: maxVal, tickStep: stepSmall };
    }
    if (dataMin < 0) {
      var mn2 = Math.floor(dataMin / stepLarge) * stepLarge;
      var mx2 = Math.ceil(dataMax / stepLarge) * stepLarge;
      if (mn2 >= mx2) {
        mn2 -= stepLarge;
        mx2 += stepLarge;
      }
      return { minVal: mn2, maxVal: mx2, tickStep: stepLarge };
    }
    var mx3 =
      MODE_HBAR.valueMax != null ? Number(MODE_HBAR.valueMax) : Math.max(stepLarge, Math.ceil(dataMax / stepLarge) * stepLarge);
    var mn3 = MODE_HBAR.valueMin != null ? Number(MODE_HBAR.valueMin) : 0;
    if (!isFinite(mx3) || mx3 <= mn3) {
      mx3 = Math.ceil(dataMax / stepLarge) * stepLarge;
      mn3 = 0;
    }
    return { minVal: mn3, maxVal: mx3, tickStep: stepLarge };
  }

  /** Vertical grouped columns (L / R / Diff) per mode; values printed on bars when showCandleValueLabels. */
  function render_mode_chart_svg_vertical(rows, axisCfg) {
    var pw = MODE_HBAR.plotWidth > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.plotWidth : CHART.width;
    var plotH = MODE_HBAR.verticalPlotHeight > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.verticalPlotHeight : 340;
    var pad = { top: 40, right: 28, bottom: 72, left: 58 };
    var ph = pad.top + plotH + pad.bottom;
    var plotLeft = pad.left;
    var plotRight = pw - pad.right;
    var plotW = Math.max(plotRight - plotLeft, 1);
    var plotTop = pad.top;
    var plotBottom = plotTop + plotH;

    var minVal = axisCfg.minVal;
    var maxVal = axisCfg.maxVal;
    var tickStep = axisCfg.tickStep;
    if (!isFinite(minVal) || !isFinite(maxVal) || minVal >= maxVal) {
      minVal = 0;
      maxVal = MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor : 140;
      tickStep = MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep : 20;
    }
    var valRange = Math.max(maxVal - minVal, 1e-9);

    function yAt(val) {
      return plotBottom - ((Number(val) - minVal) / valRange) * plotH;
    }

    var axisClr = CHART.axisColor;
    var gridClr = "#e8eaed";
    var baseFs = MODE_CHART.fontSize != null ? MODE_CHART.fontSize : pts3_axis_font();
    var axisTickFs =
      MODE_HBAR.candleAxisTickFontPx != null && MODE_HBAR.candleAxisTickFontPx > 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleAxisTickFontPx)
        : Math.max(8, baseFs - (MODE_HBAR.xTickFontShrink > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.xTickFontShrink : 5));
    var valueLabelFs =
      MODE_HBAR.candleValueFontPx != null && MODE_HBAR.candleValueFontPx > 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleValueFontPx)
        : Math.max(7, axisTickFs - 1);
    var titleFs =
      MODE_HBAR.candleTitleFontPx != null && MODE_HBAR.candleTitleFontPx > 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleTitleFontPx)
        : Math.max(11, axisTickFs + 2);
    var modeLabelFs =
      MODE_HBAR.candleModeLabelFontPx != null && MODE_HBAR.candleModeLabelFontPx > 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleModeLabelFontPx)
        : axisTickFs;

    var svgFontStyle =
      "max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;font-family:" + PTS3_SANS_FONT_STACK_CSS + ";";
    var svg =
      '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg pts3-mode-bar-chart pts3-mode-vbar-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' +
      pw +
      " " +
      ph +
      '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="' +
      svgFontStyle +
      '"><g>';

    for (var yTick = minVal; yTick <= maxVal + tickStep * 1e-6; yTick += tickStep) {
      var yy = yAt(yTick);
      svg +=
        '<line x1="' +
        plotLeft +
        '" y1="' +
        yy +
        '" x2="' +
        plotRight +
        '" y2="' +
        yy +
        '" stroke="' +
        gridClr +
        '" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.95" shape-rendering="crispEdges"/>';
      svg +=
        '<text x="' +
        (plotLeft - 8) +
        '" y="' +
        (yy + axisTickFs * 0.35) +
        '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' +
        axisTickFs +
        '" fill="' +
        axisClr +
        '">' +
        format_num(yTick) +
        "</text>";
    }

    if (minVal < 0 && maxVal > 0) {
      var y0line = yAt(0);
      if (y0line >= plotTop && y0line <= plotBottom) {
        svg +=
          '<line x1="' +
          plotLeft +
          '" y1="' +
          y0line +
          '" x2="' +
          plotRight +
          '" y2="' +
          y0line +
          '" stroke="' +
          axisClr +
          '" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" opacity="0.55"/>';
      }
    }

    svg +=
      '<line x1="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y1="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" x2="' +
      plotRight +
      '" y2="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" stroke="' +
      axisClr +
      '" stroke-width="1.25"/>';
    svg +=
      '<line x1="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y1="' +
      plotTop +
      '" x2="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y2="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" stroke="' +
      axisClr +
      '" stroke-width="1.25"/>';

    svg +=
      '<text x="' +
      (plotLeft + plotW / 2) +
      '" y="22" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' +
      titleFs +
      '" font-weight="600" fill="' +
      axisClr +
      '">Value</text>';

    var nModes = rows.length;
    var groupPad = 14;
    var gapBetweenGroups =
      MODE_HBAR.candleGroupGap != null && MODE_HBAR.candleGroupGap >= 0 ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleGroupGap) : 24;
    var innerG =
      MODE_HBAR.candleInnerGap != null && MODE_HBAR.candleInnerGap >= 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleInnerGap)
        : MODE_HBAR.innerGap != null
          ? Number(MODE_HBAR.innerGap)
          : 4;
    var contentW = Math.max(plotW - 2 * groupPad, 1);
    var totalBetweenGaps = Math.max(0, nModes - 1) * gapBetweenGroups;
    var groupSlotW = Math.max((contentW - totalBetweenGaps) / Math.max(nModes, 1), 1);
    var nBars = 3;
    var barW = Math.max(6, (groupSlotW - innerG * (nBars + 1)) / nBars);
    var wScale =
      MODE_HBAR.candleWidthScale != null && isFinite(Number(MODE_HBAR.candleWidthScale)) && Number(MODE_HBAR.candleWidthScale) > 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleWidthScale)
        : 1;
    barW = Math.max(3, barW * wScale);
    var clusterW = nBars * barW + (nBars - 1) * innerG;
    if (clusterW > groupSlotW - 1) {
      var maxBar = Math.max(3, (groupSlotW - 1 - (nBars - 1) * innerG) / nBars);
      barW = Math.min(barW, maxBar);
      clusterW = nBars * barW + (nBars - 1) * innerG;
    }
    var usePack = MODE_HBAR.candlePackGroups !== false;
    var csp =
      MODE_HBAR.candleClusterSidePad != null && MODE_HBAR.candleClusterSidePad >= 0
        ? Number(MODE_HBAR.candleClusterSidePad)
        : 6;
    var packSlotW = clusterW + 2 * csp;
    var totalPackW = nModes * packSlotW + Math.max(0, nModes - 1) * gapBetweenGroups;
    var slotW = groupSlotW;
    var baseLeft = plotLeft + groupPad;
    if (usePack && totalPackW <= contentW) {
      slotW = packSlotW;
      var packAlign = String(MODE_HBAR.candlePackHAlign || "left").toLowerCase();
      if (packAlign === "center") {
        baseLeft = plotLeft + groupPad + (contentW - totalPackW) / 2;
      }
    }
    var cornerMax = MODE_HBAR.barCornerRadius > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.barCornerRadius : 10;
    var rx = Math.min(barW / 2, cornerMax);
    var fills = [CHART.barP1, CHART.barP2, CHART.barDiff];
    var seriesNames = ["Left", "Right", "Difference"];
    var baseVal = minVal < 0 && maxVal > 0 ? 0 : minVal;
    var yBase = yAt(baseVal);

    var regions = [];

    for (var mi = 0; mi < nModes; mi++) {
      var gLeft = baseLeft + mi * (slotW + gapBetweenGroups);
      var gx0 = gLeft + (slotW - clusterW) / 2;

      var vals = [rows[mi].left, rows[mi].right, rows[mi].diff];
      for (var k = 0; k < nBars; k++) {
        var bx = gx0 + k * (barW + innerG);
        var v = Number(vals[k]);
        var yTop = yAt(v);
        var yRectTop = Math.min(yTop, yBase);
        var hRect = Math.max(Math.abs(yBase - yTop), 0.75);

        svg +=
          '<rect x="' +
          bx +
          '" y="' +
          yRectTop +
          '" width="' +
          barW +
          '" height="' +
          hRect +
          '" rx="' +
          rx +
          '" ry="' +
          rx +
          '" fill="' +
          fills[k] +
          '" stroke="none" shape-rendering="geometricPrecision"/>';

        var tipHtml =
          "<strong>" +
          escape_html(rows[mi].label) +
          "</strong><br><span style=\"color:" +
          fills[k] +
          '">■</span> ' +
          seriesNames[k] +
          ": " +
          escape_html(format_num(v));
        regions.push({
          x0: bx,
          x1: bx + barW,
          y0: yRectTop,
          y1: yRectTop + hRect,
          html: tipHtml
        });

        if (MODE_HBAR.showCandleValueLabels !== false) {
          var lab = format_num(v);
          var ty = yRectTop - 3;
