          var tx = bx + barW / 2;
          var anchor = "middle";
          var tfill = axisClr;
          if (ty < plotTop + valueLabelFs + 4) {
            ty = yRectTop + hRect + valueLabelFs + 3;
            if (ty > plotBottom + valueLabelFs + 2) {
              tx = bx + barW + 4;
              ty = yRectTop + Math.min(hRect * 0.72, valueLabelFs + 2);
              anchor = "start";
            }
          }
          if (hRect >= 4 || anchor === "start") {
            svg +=
              '<text x="' +
              tx +
              '" y="' +
              ty +
              '" text-anchor="' +
              anchor +
              '" font-size="' +
              valueLabelFs +
              '" fill="' +
              tfill +
              '" font-weight="600">' +
              escape_html(lab) +
              "</text>";
          }
        }
      }

      svg +=
        '<text x="' +
        (gLeft + slotW / 2) +
        '" y="' +
        (plotBottom + 28) +
        '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' +
        modeLabelFs +
        '" fill="' +
        axisClr +
        '" font-weight="500">' +
        escape_html(rows[mi].label) +
        "</text>";
    }

    svg +=
      '<text x="' +
      (plotLeft + plotW / 2) +
      '" y="' +
      (ph - 8) +
      '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' +
      titleFs +
      '" fill="' +
      axisClr +
      '">Mode</text>';

    svg += "</g></svg>";
    return { svg: svg, pack: { pw: pw, ph: ph, regions: regions } };
  }

  function render_mode_chart_svg(modeData) {
    var order = ["Mode1", "Mode2", "Mode3", "Mode0"];
    var rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      var v = get_mode_value(modeData, order[i]);
      if (v && typeof v === "object") {
        rows.push({
          label: order[i],
          left: v.p1 != null ? Number(v.p1) : 0,
          right: v.p2 != null ? Number(v.p2) : 0,
          diff: v.diff != null ? Number(v.diff) : 0
        });
      }
    }
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return { svg: "", pack: null };
    }

    var axisCfg = compute_mode_hbar_axis(rows);
    if (MODE_HBAR.verticalCandles !== false) {
      return render_mode_chart_svg_vertical(rows, axisCfg);
    }

    var pw = MODE_HBAR.plotWidth > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.plotWidth : CHART.width;
    var rowBand = MODE_HBAR.rowBand > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.rowBand : 56;
    var innerGapCfg = MODE_HBAR.innerGap != null ? MODE_HBAR.innerGap : 4;
    var pad = { top: 28, right: 28, bottom: 52, left: 14 };
    var labelColW = MODE_HBAR.labelColW > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.labelColW : 100;
    var ph = pad.top + pad.bottom + rows.length * rowBand;

    var plotLeft = pad.left + labelColW;
    var plotRight = pw - pad.right;
    var plotW = Math.max(plotRight - plotLeft, 1);
    var plotTop = pad.top;
    var plotBottom = ph - pad.bottom;

    var minVal = axisCfg.minVal;
    var maxVal = axisCfg.maxVal;
    var tickStep = axisCfg.tickStep;
    if (!isFinite(minVal) || !isFinite(maxVal) || minVal >= maxVal) {
      minVal = 0;
      maxVal = MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactAxisFloor : 140;
      tickStep = MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.compactTickStep : 20;
    }
    var valRange = Math.max(maxVal - minVal, 1e-9);

    function xAt(val) {
      return plotLeft + ((Number(val) - minVal) / valRange) * plotW;
    }

    function hBarGeom(val) {
      var baseVal = minVal < 0 && maxVal > 0 ? 0 : minVal;
      var xb = xAt(baseVal);
      var xv = xAt(val);
      xb = Math.max(plotLeft, Math.min(plotRight, xb));
      xv = Math.max(plotLeft, Math.min(plotRight, xv));
      var bx = Math.min(xb, xv);
      var bw = Math.max(Math.abs(xv - xb), 0.5);
      if (bx + bw > plotRight) {
        bw = plotRight - bx;
      }
      return { x: bx, w: Math.max(bw, 0.75) };
    }

    var axisClr = CHART.axisColor;
    var gridClr = "#e8eaed";
    var fs = MODE_CHART.fontSize != null ? MODE_CHART.fontSize : pts3_axis_font();
    var fsSmall = Math.max(6, fs - 2);
    var svgFontStyle =
      "max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;font-family:" + PTS3_SANS_FONT_STACK_CSS + ";";
    var svg =
      '<svg class="pts3-chart-svg pts3-mode-bar-chart pts3-mode-hbar-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' +
      pw +
      " " +
      ph +
      '" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="' +
      svgFontStyle +
      '"><g>';

    var xfs = Math.max(7, fs - (MODE_HBAR.xTickFontShrink > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.xTickFontShrink : 5));
    for (var xVal = minVal; xVal <= maxVal + tickStep * 1e-6; xVal += tickStep) {
      var xx = xAt(xVal);
      svg +=
        '<line x1="' +
        xx +
        '" y1="' +
        plotTop +
        '" x2="' +
        xx +
        '" y2="' +
        plotBottom +
        '" stroke="' +
        gridClr +
        '" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.95" shape-rendering="crispEdges"/>';
      svg +=
        '<text x="' +
        xx +
        '" y="' +
        (ph - 14) +
        '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' +
        xfs +
        '" fill="' +
        axisClr +
        '">' +
        format_num(xVal) +
        "</text>";
    }

    if (minVal < 0 && maxVal > 0) {
      var xz = xAt(0);
      if (xz >= plotLeft && xz <= plotRight) {
        svg +=
          '<line x1="' +
          xz +
          '" y1="' +
          plotTop +
          '" x2="' +
          xz +
          '" y2="' +
          plotBottom +
          '" stroke="' +
          axisClr +
          '" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" opacity="0.5"/>';
      }
    }

    svg +=
      '<line x1="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y1="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" x2="' +
      plotRight +
      '" y2="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" stroke="' +
      axisClr +
      '" stroke-width="1.25"/>';
    svg +=
      '<line x1="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y1="' +
      plotTop +
      '" x2="' +
      plotLeft +
      '" y2="' +
      plotBottom +
      '" stroke="' +
      axisClr +
      '" stroke-width="1.25"/>';

    var innerGap = innerGapCfg;
    var nBars = 3;
    var barH = Math.max(8, (rowBand - innerGap * (nBars + 1)) / nBars);
    var fills = [CHART.barP1, CHART.barP2, CHART.barDiff];
    var seriesNames = ["Left", "Right", "Difference"];
    var baseValForBar = minVal < 0 && maxVal > 0 ? 0 : minVal;
    var cornerMax = MODE_HBAR.barCornerRadius > 0 ? MODE_HBAR.barCornerRadius : 10;
    var rx = Math.min(barH / 2, cornerMax);

    var regions = [];

    for (var ri = 0; ri < rows.length; ri++) {
      var yRowTop = plotTop + ri * rowBand;
      svg +=
        '<text x="' +
        (pad.left + labelColW - 10) +
        '" y="' +
        (yRowTop + rowBand / 2 + fs * 0.35) +
        '" text-anchor="end" font-size="' +
        fs +
        '" font-weight="500" fill="' +
        axisClr +
        '">' +
        escape_html(rows[ri].label) +
        "</text>";

      var vals = [rows[ri].left, rows[ri].right, rows[ri].diff];
      for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        var yb = yRowTop + innerGap + k * (barH + innerGap);
        var hg = hBarGeom(vals[k]);
        svg +=
          '<rect x="' +
          hg.x +
          '" y="' +
          yb +
          '" width="' +
          hg.w +
          '" height="' +
          barH +
          '" rx="' +
          rx +
          '" ry="' +
          rx +
          '" fill="' +
          fills[k] +
          '" stroke="none" shape-rendering="geometricPrecision"/>';

        var tipHtml =
          "<strong>" +
          escape_html(rows[ri].label) +
          "</strong><br><span style=\"color:" +
          fills[k] +
          '">■</span> ' +
          seriesNames[k] +
          ": " +
          escape_html(format_num(vals[k]));
        regions.push({
          x0: hg.x,
          x1: hg.x + hg.w,
          y0: yb,
          y1: yb + barH,
          html: tipHtml
        });

        if (MODE_HBAR.showBarValueLabels) {
          var midX = hg.x + hg.w / 2;
          var inside = hg.w > fs * 3.2;
          var tx;
          var tAnchor;
          var tFill;
          var tWeight;
          if (inside) {
            tx = midX;
            tAnchor = "middle";
            tFill = "#fff";
            tWeight = "600";
          } else if (Number(vals[k]) >= baseValForBar) {
            tx = hg.x + hg.w + 5;
            tAnchor = "start";
            tFill = axisClr;
            tWeight = "400";
          } else {
            tx = hg.x - 5;
            tAnchor = "end";
            tFill = axisClr;
            tWeight = "400";
          }
          svg +=
            '<text x="' +
            tx +
            '" y="' +
            (yb + barH * 0.72) +
            '" text-anchor="' +
            tAnchor +
            '" font-size="' +
            fsSmall +
            '" fill="' +
            tFill +
            '" font-weight="' +
            tWeight +
            '">' +
            format_num(vals[k]) +
            "</text>";
        }
      }
    }

    svg +=
      '<text x="' +
      (plotLeft + plotW / 2) +
      '" y="' +
      (ph - 2) +
      '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' +
      Math.max(9, fs - 2) +
      '" fill="' +
      axisClr +
      '">Value</text>';
    svg += "</g></svg>";
    return { svg: svg, pack: { pw: pw, ph: ph, regions: regions } };
  }

  function render_mode(frm) {
    var m = safe_json(frm.doc.mode_values_json, null);
    if (!m || typeof m !== "object" || Object.keys(m).length === 0) {
      return '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Mode Results</h4><p class="pts3-result-no-data">No mode data</p></div>';
    }
    var order = ["Mode1", "Mode2", "Mode3", "Mode0"];
    var html = '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Mode Results</h4>';
    var legendPx =
      MODE_HBAR.legendFontPx != null && MODE_HBAR.legendFontPx > 0
        ? MODE_HBAR.legendFontPx
        : MODE_CHART.fontSize != null
          ? MODE_CHART.fontSize
          : pts3_axis_font();
    html +=
      '<div class="pts3-mode-legend" style="font-size:' +
      legendPx +
      "px;font-family:" +
      PTS3_SANS_FONT_STACK_CSS +
      ';"><span style="color:' +
      CHART.barP1 +
      '">■</span> Left &nbsp; <span style="color:' +
      CHART.barP2 +
      '">■</span> Right &nbsp; <span style="color:' +
      CHART.barDiff +
      '">■</span> Difference</div>';
    var chartOut = render_mode_chart_svg(m);
    var packEnc = "";
    if (chartOut.pack && chartOut.pack.regions && chartOut.pack.regions.length) {
      try {
        packEnc = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(chartOut.pack));
      } catch (ePack) {
        packEnc = "";
      }
    }
    html += '<div class="pts3-mode-layout">';
    html += '<div class="pts3-mode-chart pts3-mode-chart-only"><div class="pts3-chart-wrap">';
    if (packEnc && chartOut.svg) {
      html +=
        '<div class="pts3-mode-chart-container" data-mode-regions="' +
        packEnc +
        '" style="position:relative;display:block;">' +
        '<div class="pts3-mode-tooltip pts3-sweep-tooltip"></div>' +
        chartOut.svg +
        "</div>";
    } else {
      html += chartOut.svg || "";
    }
    html += "</div></div></div>";
    html += "</div>";
    return html;
  }

  function render_lrd_summary(frm) {
    var t = safe_json(frm.doc.left_right_diff_summary_json, null);
    if (!t || typeof t !== "object") {
      return '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Left / Right / Diff Summary</h4><p class="pts3-result-no-data">No data</p></div>';
    }
    var meta = t.metadata || {};
    var left = t.left || {};
    var right = t.right || {};
    var diff = t.diff || {};
    var keys = Object.keys(left).concat(Object.keys(right)).concat(Object.keys(diff));
    keys = keys.filter(function (k, i, a) { return a.indexOf(k) === i; }).sort();
    var html = '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Left / Right / Diff Summary</h4>';
    if (Object.keys(meta).length) {
      html += "<p><strong>Metadata:</strong> " + escape_html(JSON.stringify(meta)) + "</p>";
    }
    html += "<table class=\"pts3-result-table\"><thead><tr><th>Key</th><th>Left</th><th>Right</th><th>Diff</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var k = keys[i];
      html +=
        "<tr><td>" +
        escape_html(k) +
        "</td><td>" +
        escape_html(left[k] != null ? left[k] : "") +
        "</td><td>" +
        escape_html(right[k] != null ? right[k] : "") +
        "</td>" +
        pts3_diff_td_open(diff[k]) +
        escape_html(diff[k] != null ? diff[k] : "") +
        "</td></tr>";
    }
    html += "</tbody></table></div>";
    return html;
  }

  function render_artifacts(frm) {
    var ap = frm.doc.artifact_paths || "";
    var html = '<div class="pts3-result-section"><h4>Artifacts</h4>';
    var obj = null;
    if (typeof ap === "string" && ap.trim()) {
      try {
        obj = JSON.parse(ap);
      } catch (e) {
        obj = null;
      }
    }
    if (obj && typeof obj === "object") {
      var pc = obj.pc_name || "";
      var excel = obj.excel_path || "";
      var log = obj.log_path || "";
      var plot = obj.plot_path || "";
      html += "<div class=\"pts3-result-artifact\"><strong>PC:</strong> " + escape_html(pc || "(not set)") + "</div>";
      html += "<div class=\"pts3-result-artifact\"><strong>Excel:</strong> " + escape_html(excel || "-") + "</div>";
      html += "<div class=\"pts3-result-artifact\"><strong>Log:</strong> " + escape_html(log || "-") + "</div>";
      html += "<div class=\"pts3-result-artifact\"><strong>Plot:</strong> " + escape_html(plot || "-") + "</div>";
    } else if (ap && typeof ap === "string") {
      html += "<div class=\"pts3-result-artifact\"><strong>Legacy path:</strong> " + escape_html(ap) + "</div>";
    } else {
      html += "<p class=\"pts3-result-no-data\">No artifact paths</p>";
    }
    html += "</div>";
    return html;
  }

  function load_html2canvas(done) {
    if (typeof window.html2canvas === "function") {
      done();
      return;
    }
    if (window.__pts3_h2c_loading) {
      window.__pts3_h2c_queue = window.__pts3_h2c_queue || [];
      window.__pts3_h2c_queue.push(done);
      return;
    }
    window.__pts3_h2c_loading = true;
    var sc = document.createElement("script");
    sc.src = HTML2CANVAS_CDN;
    sc.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    sc.onload = function () {
      window.__pts3_h2c_loading = false;
      done();
      var q = window.__pts3_h2c_queue || [];
      window.__pts3_h2c_queue = [];
      for (var qi = 0; qi < q.length; qi++) {
        q[qi]();
      }
    };
    sc.onerror = function () {
      window.__pts3_h2c_loading = false;
      frappe.msgprint(__("Could not load html2canvas (CDN blocked or offline)."));
    };
    document.head.appendChild(sc);
  }

  function bind_inspection_download(frm, $wrapper) {
    $wrapper.find(".pts3-download-inspection-png").off("click.pts3cap");
    $wrapper.find(".pts3-download-inspection-png").on("click.pts3cap", function () {
      var root = $wrapper.find(".pts3-inspection-capture-body")[0];
      if (!root) {
        frappe.msgprint(__("Nothing to capture."));
        return;
      }
      load_html2canvas(function () {
        frappe.show_alert({ message: __("Rendering PNG…"), indicator: "blue" });
        var bg = "#ffffff";
        try {
          var b = getComputedStyle(document.body);
          if (b && b.backgroundColor && b.backgroundColor !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" && b.backgroundColor !== "transparent") {
            bg = b.backgroundColor;
          }
        } catch (e0) {}
        window
          .html2canvas(root, {
            scale: INSPECTION_PNG_SCALE,
            useCORS: true,
            allowTaint: true,
            logging: false,
            backgroundColor: bg,
            ignoreElements: function (el) {
              return el.classList && el.classList.contains("pts3-inspection-toolbar");
            },
          })
          .then(function (canvas) {
            canvas.toBlob(
              function (blob) {
                if (!blob) {
                  frappe.msgprint(__("PNG export failed."));
                  return;
                }
                var name = (frm.doc.name || "PTS3_Result").replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "_");
                var a = document.createElement("a");
                a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                a.download = name + "_inspection.png";
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
                frappe.show_alert({ message: __("Download started"), indicator: "green" });
              },
              "image/png",
              0.98
            );
          })
          .catch(function (err) {
            frappe.msgprint(__("Capture error: ") + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
          });
      });
    });
  }

  function render_inspection(frm) {
    if (!frm.doc.name) return "";
    var inner =
      '<div class="pts3-summary-mode-row">' +
      render_summary(frm) +
      render_mode(frm) +
      "</div>" +
      render_step_sweep(frm);
    if (SHOW_LEFT_RIGHT_DIFF_SUMMARY_SECTION) {
      inner += render_lrd_summary(frm);
    }
    inner += render_artifacts(frm);
    return (
      '<div class="pts3-inspection-capture-root" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;display:block;">' +
      '<table role="presentation" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0;padding:0;border:none;"><tr><td style="padding:0;border:none;vertical-align:top;width:100%;">' +
      '<div class="pts3-inspection-toolbar">' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-default btn-sm pts3-download-inspection-png">' +
      __("Download inspection as PNG") +
      "</button>" +
      '<span class="text-muted small">' +
      __("Uses html2canvas from CDN; scale ") +
      String(INSPECTION_PNG_SCALE) +
      "×</span></div>" +
      '<div class="pts3-inspection-capture-body" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;">' +
      inner +
      "</div></td></tr></table></div>"
    );
  }

  function setup_sweep_hover() {
    $(document).off("mousemove.pts3sweep mouseleave.pts3sweep");
    $(document).on("mousemove.pts3sweep", ".pts3-sweep-chart-container", function (e) {
      var $c = $(this);
      var dataStr = $c.attr("data-sweep");
      if (!dataStr) return;
      var data;
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(dataStr);
      } catch (err) {
        return;
      }
      var coords = data.coords;
      var freqs = data.freqs || [];
      var left = data.left || [];
      var right = data.right || [];
      var diff = data.diff || [];
      if (!coords || !freqs.length) return;
      var svg = $c.find("svg")[0];
      if (!svg) return;
      var rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
      var vx = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * coords.pw;
      var vy = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * coords.ph;
      if (vx < coords.gx || vx > coords.gx + coords.gw || vy < coords.gy || vy > coords.gy + coords.gh) {
        $c.find(".pts3-sweep-tooltip").removeClass("visible");
        return;
      }
      var freq = coords.freqMin + ((vx - coords.gx) / coords.gw) * coords.freqRange;
      var idx = Math.round(((vx - coords.gx) / coords.gw) * (freqs.length - 1));
      idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, freqs.length - 1));
      var f = Number(freqs[idx]);
      var l = left[idx] != null ? format_num(left[idx]) : "-";
      var r = right[idx] != null ? format_num(right[idx]) : "-";
      var d = diff[idx] != null ? format_num(diff[idx]) : "-";
      var $tip = $c.find(".pts3-sweep-tooltip");
      var cRect = $c[0].getBoundingClientRect();
      $tip.html("<strong>" + f + " Hz</strong><br>Left: " + l + " &nbsp; Right: " + r + " &nbsp; Diff: " + d);
      $tip.css({ left: (e.clientX - cRect.left + 12) + "px", top: (e.clientY - cRect.top + 12) + "px" });
      $tip.addClass("visible");
    });
    $(document).on("mouseleave.pts3sweep", ".pts3-sweep-chart-container", function () {
      $(this).find(".pts3-sweep-tooltip").removeClass("visible");
    });
  }

  function setup_mode_hover() {
    $(document).off("mousemove.pts3mode mouseleave.pts3mode");
    $(document).on("mousemove.pts3mode", ".pts3-mode-chart-container", function (e) {
      var $c = $(this);
      var raw = $c.attr("data-mode-regions");
      if (!raw) return;
      var pack;
      try {
        pack = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
      } catch (err) {
        return;
      }
      if (!pack || !pack.regions || !pack.regions.length) return;
      var svg = $c.find("svg")[0];
      if (!svg) return;
      var srect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!srect.width || !srect.height) return;
      var vx = ((e.clientX - srect.left) / srect.width) * pack.pw;
      var vy = ((e.clientY - srect.top) / srect.height) * pack.ph;
      var hit = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < pack.regions.length; i++) {
        var r = pack.regions[i];
        if (vx >= r.x0 && vx <= r.x1 && vy >= r.y0 && vy <= r.y1) {
          hit = r;
          break;
        }
      }
      var $tip = $c.find(".pts3-mode-tooltip");
      if (!hit) {
        $tip.removeClass("visible");
        return;
      }
      $tip.html(hit.html);
      var cRect = $c[0].getBoundingClientRect();
      $tip.css({ left: e.clientX - cRect.left + 12 + "px", top: e.clientY - cRect.top + 12 + "px" });
      $tip.addClass("visible");
    });
    $(document).on("mouseleave.pts3mode", ".pts3-mode-chart-container", function () {
      $(this).find(".pts3-mode-tooltip").removeClass("visible");
    });
  }

  /** Same as Desk → user menu → Toggle Full Width (ON). Persists in localStorage like the built-in toggle. */
  function pts3_ensure_desk_full_width() {
    if (!PTS3_ENABLE_DESK_FULL_WIDTH_ON_LOAD) return;
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
        localStorage.setItem("container_fullwidth", "true");
      }
      if (typeof frappe !== "undefined" && frappe.ui && frappe.ui.toolbar && typeof frappe.ui.toolbar.set_fullwidth_if_enabled === "function") {
        frappe.ui.toolbar.set_fullwidth_if_enabled();
      } else if (typeof $ !== "undefined" && $(document.body).length) {
        $(document.body).addClass("full-width");
      }
      if (typeof $ !== "undefined") {
        $(document.body).trigger("toggleFullWidth");
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  frappe.ui.form.on("PTS3 Result", {
    onload: function () {
      setTimeout(pts3_ensure_desk_full_width, 0);
    },
    refresh: function (frm) {
      pts3_ensure_desk_full_width();
      pts3Dbg(
        "PTS3 Result refresh",
        frm.doc.name,
        "run_id=" + (frm.doc.run_id || ""),
        "op=" + (frm.doc.operation || ""),
        "final_graph_json len=" + String(frm.doc.final_graph_json || "").length,
        "left_right_diff_summary_json len=" + String(frm.doc.left_right_diff_summary_json || "").length,
        "mode_values_json len=" + String(frm.doc.mode_values_json || "").length
      );
      var field = frm.get_field("result_inspection");
      if (field && field.$wrapper) {
        field.$wrapper.addClass("pts3-result-inspection-field-wrap");
        field.$wrapper.html(render_inspection(frm));
        setup_sweep_hover();
        setup_mode_hover();
        bind_inspection_download(frm, field.$wrapper);
      }
    }
  });
})();


//pts3_api server script
# ============================================================
# PTS3 Server API - pts3_api
# Source: 11_CONNECTOR_ENDPOINTS.md, 13_SPEC_RECONCILIATION.md,
#         18_FINAL_DOCTYPE_SPEC_REVISED.md
#
# RestrictedPython-safe: NO f-strings, NO .format(), NO unsafe imports
# Do NOT name functions with a leading underscore (Server Script compile will fail).
# Do NOT use tuple unpacking (a, b = fn()) — use t = fn(); a = t[0]; b = t[1] (RestrictedPython).
#
# Deploy: Create Server Script, script_type=API, api_method=pts3_api
# ============================================================

form = frappe.form_dict or {}

# Bump this when redeploying to verify server is updated
PTS3_API_VERSION = "pts3_api_session_upsert_v2"

# --------- payload extraction ----------
payload = {}
wrapped = form.get("args")
if isinstance(wrapped, dict):
    for k in wrapped:
        payload[k] = wrapped[k]
elif isinstance(wrapped, str):
    try:
        j = frappe.parse_json(wrapped)
        if isinstance(j, dict):
            for k in j:
                payload[k] = j[k]
    except Exception:
        pass
for k in form:
    if k != "args" and k != "cmd":
        payload[k] = form[k]

api_cmd = (payload.get("api_cmd") or "").strip().lower()
docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()

# --------- helpers ----------
def to_dict(x):
    if not x:
        return {}
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        return x
    try:
        v = frappe.parse_json(x)
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            return v
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}

def normalize_json_object(val):
    """If nested payload arrived as a JSON string, parse to dict (Frappe sometimes stringifies nested keys)."""
    if isinstance(val, dict):
        return val
    if isinstance(val, str) and val.strip():
        try:
            v = frappe.parse_json(val)
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                return v
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}

def sweep_payload_present(graph, table):
    """True if we have freqs+series or L/R/D maps with keys (metadata-only table is NOT enough)."""
    g = graph if isinstance(graph, dict) else {}
    if g.get("type") in ("sweep", "step_sweep"):
        freqs = g.get("freqs") or []
        if len(freqs) >= 2:
            return True
    t = table if isinstance(table, dict) else {}
    for kk in ("left", "right", "diff"):
        d = t.get(kk)
        if isinstance(d, dict) and len(d) > 0:
            return True
    return False

def fill_lrd_from_sweep_graph(r, graph, table):
    """If graph is sweep with freqs but L/R/D maps are empty, build maps from left/right/diff arrays."""
    if not isinstance(graph, dict) or graph.get("type") not in ("sweep", "step_sweep"):
        return graph, table
    if not isinstance(table, dict):
        table = {}
    freqs = graph.get("freqs") or []
    if not freqs:
        return graph, table
    le = table.get("left")
    ri = table.get("right")
    di = table.get("diff")
    le = le if isinstance(le, dict) else {}
    ri = ri if isinstance(ri, dict) else {}
    di = di if isinstance(di, dict) else {}
    if len(le) + len(ri) + len(di) > 0:
        return graph, table
    left = graph.get("left") or []
    right = graph.get("right") or []
    diff = graph.get("diff") or []
    nl = {}
    nr = {}
    nd = {}
    idx = 0
    for hz in freqs:
        k = str(hz) + "hz"
        if idx < len(left):
            nl[k] = left[idx]
        if idx < len(right):
            nr[k] = right[idx]
        if idx < len(diff):
            nd[k] = diff[idx]
        idx = idx + 1
    table = dict(table)
    table["left"] = nl
    table["right"] = nr
    table["diff"] = nd
    r["left_right_diff_summary"] = table
    return graph, table

def pts3_result_missing_json_fieldnames():
    """Fields required to persist sweep/mode JSON. Empty list if DocType is OK."""
    meta_pr = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Result")
    have_names = {}
    for df in meta_pr.fields or []:
        have_names[df.fieldname] = 1
    need_fields = ["final_graph_json", "left_right_diff_summary_json", "mode_values_json", "raw_result_json"]
    missing_pf = []
    for nf in need_fields:
        if nf not in have_names:
            missing_pf.append(nf)
    return missing_pf


def pts3_result_serial_slug(raw):
    """Safe fragment for document name: A-Za-z0-9_- only, max 80 chars."""
    s = (raw or "").strip()
    if not s:
        s = "UNKNOWN"
    buf = []
    i = 0
    slen = len(s)
    while i < slen:
        c = s[i]
        ok = False
        if c >= "A" and c <= "Z":
            ok = True
        if c >= "a" and c <= "z":
            ok = True
        if c >= "0" and c <= "9":
            ok = True
        if c == "_" or c == "-":
            ok = True
        if ok:
            buf.append(c)
        else:
            buf.append("_")
        i = i + 1
    s2 = "".join(buf)
    while "__" in s2:
        s2 = s2.replace("__", "_")
    s2 = s2.strip("_")
    if not s2:
        s2 = "UNKNOWN"
    if len(s2) > 80:
        s2 = s2[0:80]
    return s2


def pts3_result_op_kind(operation):
    """Bucket for name: sweep (step_sweep/submit) or mode (mode* / full_test)."""
    op = (operation or "").strip()
    if op == "step_sweep" or op == "submit":
        return "sweep"
    if op == "mode1" or op == "mode2" or op == "mode3" or op == "mode0" or op == "full_test":
        return "mode"
    return "sweep"


def pts3_result_next_series_num(serial_slug, kind):
    """Next integer suffix for pts3_<slug>_<kind>_<n>."""
    prefix = "pts3_%s_%s_" % (serial_slug, kind)
    rows = frappe.db.sql("SELECT name FROM `tabPTS3 Result` WHERE name LIKE %s", (prefix + "%",))
    nmax = 0
    plen = len(prefix)
    for row in rows:
        nm = row[0]
        if not nm.startswith(prefix):
            continue
        tail = nm[plen:]
        try:
            num = int(tail)
            if num > nmax:
                nmax = num
        except Exception:
            pass
    return nmax + 1


def pts3_result_alloc_name(serial, operation):
    """Unique name: pts3_<serial_slug>_sweep|mode_<series>. DocType autoname must be Prompt."""
    slug = pts3_result_serial_slug(serial)
    kind = pts3_result_op_kind(operation)
    prefix = "pts3_%s_%s_" % (slug, kind)
    n = pts3_result_next_series_num(slug, kind)
    attempts = 0
    while attempts < 50:
        candidate = "%s%d" % (prefix, n)
        if not frappe.db.exists("PTS3 Result", candidate):
            return candidate
        n = n + 1
        attempts = attempts + 1
    frappe.throw("PTS3 Result: could not allocate unique name")

def pts3_merge_json_dict_str(existing_json_str, incoming_dict):
    """Merge incoming dict into existing JSON string dict, return JSON string."""
    base = {}
    if isinstance(existing_json_str, str) and existing_json_str.strip():
        try:
            parsed = frappe.parse_json(existing_json_str)
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                base = dict(parsed)
        except Exception:
            base = {}
    if isinstance(incoming_dict, dict):
        for k in incoming_dict:
            base[k] = incoming_dict.get(k)
    return to_json_str(base) if base else "{}"

def pts3_alloc_session_run_id(pcb_serial_no, docname, lane_no):
    """
    Human-readable session run_id (stable across Step Sweep + Mode* in one session).
    Format: pts3run_<serial>_<testdoc>_<series>
    Example: pts3run_SUDESH_PTS3-TEST-00001_001
    """
    serial_slug = pts3_result_serial_slug(pcb_serial_no)
    test_slug = pts3_result_serial_slug(docname)
    try:
        n = frappe.db.count("PTS3 Result", {"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no}) or 0
    except Exception:
        n = 0
    series = n + 1
    attempts = 0
    while attempts < 50:
        candidate = "pts3run_%s_%s_%03d" % (serial_slug, test_slug, series)
        if not frappe.db.exists("PTS3 Result", {"run_id": candidate}):
            return candidate
        series = series + 1
        attempts = attempts + 1
    frappe.throw("PTS3: could not allocate session run_id")


def merge_result_json_into_r(r, rj):
    """Force graph + L/R/D from result_json when REST stripped nested dicts or left only metadata."""
    if not rj or not isinstance(r, dict):
        return
    try:
        pj = frappe.parse_json(rj)
        if not isinstance(pj, dict):
            return
        pg = normalize_json_object(pj.get("graph"))
        if pg and pg.get("type") in ("sweep", "step_sweep", "mode"):
            rg = normalize_json_object(r.get("graph"))
            if not rg or not rg.get("freqs"):
                r["graph"] = pg
        pt = pj.get("left_right_diff_summary") or pj.get("table") or {}
        pt = normalize_json_object(pt)
        if pt:
            le = pt.get("left") if isinstance(pt.get("left"), dict) else {}
            ri = pt.get("right") if isinstance(pt.get("right"), dict) else {}
            di = pt.get("diff") if isinstance(pt.get("diff"), dict) else {}
            if len(le) + len(ri) + len(di) > 0:
                cur = r.get("left_right_diff_summary") or r.get("table") or {}
                cur = normalize_json_object(cur) if cur else {}
                cle = cur.get("left") if isinstance(cur.get("left"), dict) else {}
                cri = cur.get("right") if isinstance(cur.get("right"), dict) else {}
                cdi = cur.get("diff") if isinstance(cur.get("diff"), dict) else {}
                if len(cle) + len(cri) + len(cdi) == 0:
                    r["left_right_diff_summary"] = pt
    except Exception:
        pass

def to_json_str(x):
    if x is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(x, str):
        return x
    try:
        return frappe.as_json(x) if x else ""
    except Exception:
        # Do not fall back to str(x): Python repr uses single-quotes; not valid JSON for the browser.
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return "{}"
        if isinstance(x, list):
            return "[]"
        return ""

def get_pts3_doc(name):
    return frappe.get_doc("PTS3 Test", name)

def get_lane_row(doc, lane_no):
    ln = int(lane_no or 0)
    for r in (doc.lanes or []):
        if int(r.lane_no or 0) == ln:
            return r
    frappe.throw("Lane not found")

def db_get(child_dt, rowname, fieldname):
    try:
        v = frappe.db.get_value(child_dt, rowname, fieldname)
        if v is None:
            return ""
        return str(v).strip()
    except Exception:
        return ""

# Internal lane_action codes (18_FINAL_DOCTYPE_SPEC_REVISED)
ALLOWED_ACTIONS = ["step_sweep", "mode1", "mode2", "mode3", "mode0", "full_test"]

out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 1. request_lane_action
# Must reject blank pcb_serial_no. Do NOT generate run_id.
# ============================================================
if api_cmd == "request_lane_action":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    action = (payload.get("action") or "").strip()

    if not docname:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname")
    if lane_no not in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        frappe.throw("lane_no must be 1..4")
    if action not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS:
        frappe.throw("action must be one of: " + ", ".join(ALLOWED_ACTIONS))

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options

    pcb_serial = (row.pcb_serial_no or "").strip()
    if not pcb_serial:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "pcb_serial_no_required"}
    else:
        # Set action and status
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action", action, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status", "Requested", update_modified=False)
        # Clear stale runtime/live/error from previous runs (keep pcb_serial_no, latest_result_id, run_id)
        # Session model: keep run_id across Step Sweep + Mode* for the same serial.
        cur_run_id = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id")
        if cur_run_id:
            try:
                existing_serial = frappe.db.get_value("PTS3 Result", {"run_id": cur_run_id}, "pcb_serial_no")
                if existing_serial and str(existing_serial).strip() and str(existing_serial).strip() != pcb_serial:
                    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "run_id", "", update_modified=False)
            except Exception:
                pass
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "connector_name", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_heartbeat_at", None, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 0, update_modified=False)
        # Keep sweep plot/table when running mode steps in the same session.
        keep_live = False
        if isinstance(action, str) and action.startswith("mode"):
            try:
                keep_live = bool(db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id"))
            except Exception:
                keep_live = False
        if not keep_live:
            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_graph_json", "", update_modified=False)
            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_table_json", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_status", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_freq", 0, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_mode", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_live_update_at", None, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_log", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "error_message", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.commit()
        out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "docname": docname, "lane_no": lane_no}

# ============================================================
# 2. request_abort
# Client sets abort_requested. Connector polls and terminates.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "request_abort":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options

    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 1, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.commit()
    out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 3. claim_lane
# Only owner of run_id creation. Only succeed if Requested.
# Sets Queued (not Running). Connector must call update_lane_fields
# with lane_action_status=Running when subprocess actually starts.
# If subprocess launch fails, connector MUST call mark_lane_failed.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "claim_lane":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    connector_name = (payload.get("connector_name") or "").strip()

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options
    rn = row.name

    cur_status = (db_get(child_dt, rn, "lane_action_status") or "").lower()

    if cur_status != "requested":
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "status_not_requested", "cur_status": cur_status}
    else:
        run_id = db_get(child_dt, rn, "run_id")
        if not run_id:
            run_id = pts3_alloc_session_run_id(row.pcb_serial_no, docname, lane_no)

        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, rn, "lane_action_status", "Queued", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, rn, "run_id", run_id, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, rn, "connector_name", connector_name, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, rn, "last_heartbeat_at", frappe.utils.now(), update_modified=False)

        frappe.db.commit()
        out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "docname": docname, "lane_no": lane_no, "run_id": run_id}

# ============================================================
# 4. update_lane_fields
# Verify run_id. Update only allowed fields.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "update_lane_fields":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    run_id = (payload.get("run_id") or "").strip()
    fields = payload.get("fields") or {}

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")
    if not run_id:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "missing_run_id"}
    else:
        doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
        row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
        child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options
        cur_run_id = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id")

        if cur_run_id != run_id:
            out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "run_id_mismatch"}
        else:
            allowed = ["live_graph_json", "live_table_json", "live_status", "live_current_freq", "live_current_mode",
                      "live_progress_message", "last_live_update_at", "last_heartbeat_at", "progress_message",
                      "lane_action_status"]
            cur_status = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status")
            for k, v in fields.items():
                if k in allowed:
                    try:
                        if k == "lane_action_status":
                            new_status = (str(v) or "").strip()
                            if new_status and cur_status == "Queued" and new_status == "Running":
                                frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, k, new_status, update_modified=False)
                        elif isinstance(v, dict) or isinstance(v, list):
                            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, k, to_json_str(v), update_modified=False)
                        elif k == "live_current_freq" and v is None:
                            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, k, 0, update_modified=False)
                        else:
                            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, k, v, update_modified=False)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            frappe.db.commit()
            out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 5. append_lane_log
# Append log_chunk to lane_log. Verify run_id.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "append_lane_log":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    run_id = (payload.get("run_id") or "").strip()
    log_chunk = payload.get("log_chunk") or ""

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")
    if not run_id:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "missing_run_id"}
    else:
        doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
        row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
        child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options
        cur_run_id = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id")

        if cur_run_id != run_id:
            out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "run_id_mismatch"}
        else:
            cur_log = frappe.db.get_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_log") or ""
            frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_log", cur_log + str(log_chunk), update_modified=False)
            frappe.db.commit()
            out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 6. save_final_result
# Session upsert model: one run_id spans multiple operations (sweep + modes).
# - same pcb_serial_no across multiple sessions = multiple PTS3 Result records (history preserved)
# - same run_id can be saved multiple times; we merge into one PTS3 Result
# - latest_result_id on lane points to the newest created result
# Map: serial->pcb_serial_no, graph->final_graph_json, table->left_right_diff_summary_json
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "save_final_result":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    run_id = (payload.get("run_id") or "").strip()
    result_in = payload.get("result")
    if not isinstance(result_in, dict):
        result_in = {}
    # Duplicate payload: REST layer may strip / stringify nested dicts on "result".
    # Connector also sends "result_json" which is guaranteed valid JSON.
    # Prefer parsed JSON as source of truth, then fill any missing keys from result_in.
    rj = payload.get("result_json") or ""
    if rj:
        try:
            parsed = frappe.parse_json(rj)
            # Do not require len(parsed)>0: empty {} still ok; merge fills from result when possible
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                base = dict(parsed)
                for k in result_in:
                    if k not in base or base.get(k) in (None, "", {}, []):
                        base[k] = result_in.get(k)
                result_in = base
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")
    if not run_id:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "missing_run_id"}
    else:
        doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
        row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
        child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options
        cur_run_id = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id")

        if cur_run_id != run_id:
            out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "run_id_mismatch"}
        else:
            # Session model: upsert by run_id (same run_id can be saved multiple times for sweep+mode steps)
            existing = frappe.db.exists("PTS3 Result", {"run_id": run_id})
            if False and existing:
                # legacy behavior (disabled)
                out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "duplicate_run_id", "run_id": run_id}
            else:
                r = to_dict(result_in)
                # REST may stringify graph/table; result_json always has full structure — merge again on r
                merge_result_json_into_r(r, rj)
                r["graph"] = normalize_json_object(r.get("graph"))
                tnorm = normalize_json_object(r.get("left_right_diff_summary")) or normalize_json_object(r.get("table"))
                if tnorm:
                    r["left_right_diff_summary"] = tnorm
                # Last resort: lane child still has live sweep from connector updates during the run
                try:
                    lg_str = frappe.db.get_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_graph_json", cache=False)
                    if lg_str:
                        try:
                            g_live = frappe.parse_json(lg_str)
                            if isinstance(g_live, dict) and g_live.get("type") in ("sweep", "step_sweep"):
                                freqs_gl = g_live.get("freqs") or []
                                if len(freqs_gl) >= 2:
                                    rg = r.get("graph")
                                    if not isinstance(rg, dict) or not rg.get("freqs"):
                                        r["graph"] = g_live
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    lt_str = frappe.db.get_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_table_json", cache=False)
                    if lt_str:
                        try:
                            t_live = frappe.parse_json(lt_str)
                            if isinstance(t_live, dict):
                                has_lrd = t_live.get("left") or t_live.get("right") or t_live.get("diff")
                                if has_lrd:
                                    cur = r.get("left_right_diff_summary") or r.get("table") or {}
                                    if not isinstance(cur, dict):
                                        cur = {}
                                    le = cur.get("left") if isinstance(cur.get("left"), dict) else {}
                                    ri = cur.get("right") if isinstance(cur.get("right"), dict) else {}
                                    di = cur.get("diff") if isinstance(cur.get("diff"), dict) else {}
                                    if len(le) == 0 and len(ri) == 0 and len(di) == 0:
                                        meta = cur.get("metadata") if isinstance(cur.get("metadata"), dict) else {}
                                        r["left_right_diff_summary"] = {
                                            "metadata": meta,
                                            "left": t_live.get("left") or {},
                                            "right": t_live.get("right") or {},
                                            "diff": t_live.get("diff") or {},
                                        }
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                except Exception:
                    pass

                operation = (r.get("operation") or "").strip()
                dt_str = r.get("datetime") or ""
                table = r.get("left_right_diff_summary") or r.get("table") or {}
                graph = r.get("graph") or {}
                mode_values = r.get("mode_values") or {}
                lrd_out = fill_lrd_from_sweep_graph(r, graph, table)
                graph = lrd_out[0]
                table = lrd_out[1]

                # Mode-only: ensure graph JSON when mode_values present but graph empty (1 or more modes)
                if isinstance(graph, dict) and len(graph) == 0 and isinstance(mode_values, dict) and len(mode_values) > 0:
                    g = {"type": "mode"}
                    for mk, mv in mode_values.items():
                        g[mk] = mv
                    graph = g
                    r["graph"] = graph

                # step_sweep: second merge from result_json if payload was still empty (REST stripped nested dicts)
                op_chk = (operation or "").strip()
                if op_chk == "step_sweep" and not sweep_payload_present(graph, table):
                    merge_result_json_into_r(r, rj)
                    graph = r.get("graph") or {}
                    table = r.get("left_right_diff_summary") or r.get("table") or {}
                    lrd_out2 = fill_lrd_from_sweep_graph(r, graph, table)
                    graph = lrd_out2[0]
                    table = lrd_out2[1]

                is_mode = isinstance(operation, str) and operation.startswith("mode")
                if not operation:
                    out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "operation_required"}
                elif not dt_str:
                    out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "datetime_required"}
                elif is_mode and (not isinstance(mode_values, dict) or len(mode_values) == 0):
                    out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "mode_values_required"}
                elif (not is_mode) and (not table or (isinstance(table, dict) and len(table) == 0)):
                    out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "left_right_diff_summary_required"}
                elif (operation or "").strip() == "step_sweep" and not sweep_payload_present(graph, table):
                    out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "sweep_payload_missing", "hint": "Deploy latest pts3_api; ensure connector sends result_json; check Role Permission read on PTS3 Result Code fields."}
                else:
                    missing_json = pts3_result_missing_json_fieldnames()
                    if len(missing_json) > 0:
                        out = {
                            "ok": False,
                            "api_cmd": api_cmd,
                            "reason": "pts3_result_doctype_missing_fields",
                            "missing_fields": missing_json,
                            "hint": "Customize DocType PTS3 Result: add Code fields final_graph_json, left_right_diff_summary_json, mode_values_json, raw_result_json. Then bench migrate and clear-cache.",
                        }
                    else:
                        serial = (r.get("serial") or r.get("pcb_serial_no") or row.pcb_serial_no or "").strip()
                        operation = operation if operation in ["submit", "step_sweep", "mode1", "mode2", "mode3", "mode0", "full_test"] else "step_sweep"
                        pass_fail = (r.get("pass_fail") or "").strip()
                        dominant_channel = (r.get("dominant_channel") or "").strip()
                        max_value = r.get("max_value")
                        if max_value is not None and not isinstance(max_value, (int, float)):
                            max_value = None
                        mode_values = r.get("mode_values") or {}
                        graph = r.get("graph") or {}
                        raw_result = r.get("raw_result") or {}
                        # Prefer connector pre-serialised JSON (valid JSON); else to_json_str (no str() repr fallback).
                        fg_str = (payload.get("pre_final_graph_json") or "").strip() or to_json_str(graph)
                        lrd_str = (payload.get("pre_lrd_json") or "").strip() or (to_json_str(table) if table else "{}")
                        mv_str = (payload.get("pre_mode_values_json") or "").strip() or to_json_str(mode_values)
                        rr_str = (payload.get("pre_raw_result_json") or "").strip() or to_json_str(raw_result)
                        ap_str = (payload.get("pre_artifact_paths_json") or "").strip()
                        if not ap_str or ap_str == "{}":
                            ap_raw = r.get("artifact_paths")
                            if isinstance(ap_raw, dict):
                                ap_str = to_json_str(ap_raw)
                            else:
                                ap_str = (ap_raw or "").strip()

                        # Normalized operation string — must be set for both new and existing PTS3 Result rows
                        # (lines below use opv after if existing / else; else path never defined opv before).
                        opv = (operation or "").strip()
                        if existing:
                            d = frappe.get_doc("PTS3 Result", existing)
                            if opv == "step_sweep" or opv == "submit":
                                d.final_graph_json = fg_str
                                d.left_right_diff_summary_json = lrd_str
                            else:
                                try:
                                    mv_parsed = frappe.parse_json(mv_str) if isinstance(mv_str, str) else {}
                                except Exception:
                                    mv_parsed = {}
                                d.mode_values_json = pts3_merge_json_dict_str(d.mode_values_json, mv_parsed)
                            try:
                                rr_parsed = frappe.parse_json(rr_str) if isinstance(rr_str, str) else {}
                            except Exception:
                                rr_parsed = {}
                            d.raw_result_json = pts3_merge_json_dict_str(d.raw_result_json, rr_parsed)
                            d.pcb_serial_no = serial or d.pcb_serial_no or "UNKNOWN"
                            d.datetime = dt_str or d.datetime
                            d.pass_fail = pass_fail if pass_fail in ["Pass", "Fail"] else (d.pass_fail or "")
                            d.dominant_channel = dominant_channel or (d.dominant_channel or "")
                            d.max_value = max_value if max_value is not None else d.max_value
                            d.artifact_paths = ap_str or (d.artifact_paths or "")
                            d.pts3_test_ref = docname
                            d.lane_no = lane_no
                            has_sweep = bool((d.final_graph_json or "").strip()) and bool((d.left_right_diff_summary_json or "").strip())
                            has_mode = bool((d.mode_values_json or "").strip()) and (d.mode_values_json or "").strip() not in ("{}", "null")
                            if has_sweep and has_mode:
                                d.operation = "full_test"
                            else:
                                d.operation = opv
                            d.save()
                            result_id = d.name
                        else:
                            res = frappe.new_doc("PTS3 Result")
                            res.name = pts3_result_alloc_name(serial, operation)
                            res.pcb_serial_no = serial or "UNKNOWN"
                            res.run_id = run_id
                            res.operation = operation if operation in ["submit", "step_sweep", "mode1", "mode2", "mode3", "mode0", "full_test"] else "step_sweep"
                            res.datetime = dt_str
                            res.left_right_diff_summary_json = lrd_str
                            res.pass_fail = pass_fail if pass_fail in ["Pass", "Fail"] else ""
                            res.dominant_channel = dominant_channel
                            res.max_value = max_value
                            res.mode_values_json = mv_str
                            res.final_graph_json = fg_str
                            res.raw_result_json = rr_str
                            res.artifact_paths = ap_str
                            res.pts3_test_ref = docname
                            res.lane_no = lane_no
                            res.insert()
                            result_id = res.name

                        # Do NOT overwrite sweep JSON during mode updates (fg_str/lrd_str may be '{}' then).
                        if opv == "step_sweep" or opv == "submit":
                            frappe.db.set_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "final_graph_json", fg_str, update_modified=False)
                            frappe.db.set_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "left_right_diff_summary_json", lrd_str, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "mode_values_json", frappe.db.get_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "mode_values_json") or mv_str, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "raw_result_json", frappe.db.get_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "raw_result_json") or rr_str, update_modified=False)

                        # Lane dashboard must mirror merged modes from PTS3 Result (not last op's mv_str only).
                        merged_mv_lane = frappe.db.get_value("PTS3 Result", result_id, "mode_values_json") or mv_str

                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status", "Done", update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "latest_result_id", result_id, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 0, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "pass_fail", pass_fail if pass_fail in ["Pass", "Fail"] else "", update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "dominant_channel", dominant_channel, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "max_value", max_value, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "mode_values_json", merged_mv_lane, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_status", "", update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_heartbeat_at", None, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_live_update_at", None, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_freq", 0, update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_mode", "", update_modified=False)
                        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "progress_message", "", update_modified=False)

                        frappe.db.commit()
                        out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "result_id": result_id}

# ============================================================
# 7. mark_lane_failed
# Set Failed, error_message. Verify run_id.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "mark_lane_failed":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)
    run_id = (payload.get("run_id") or "").strip()
    error_message = (payload.get("error_message") or "").strip()

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options
    cur_run_id = db_get(child_dt, row.name, "run_id")

    if run_id and cur_run_id != run_id:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "run_id_mismatch"}
    else:
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status", "Failed", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "error_message", error_message, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 0, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_status", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_heartbeat_at", None, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_live_update_at", None, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_freq", 0, update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_mode", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
        frappe.db.commit()
        out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 8. abort_lane
# Connector calls after terminating subprocess. Set Aborted, clear abort_requested.
# Clear live fields for clean state.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "abort_lane":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options

    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status", "Aborted", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 0, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_status", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_heartbeat_at", None, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_live_update_at", None, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_freq", 0, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_mode", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.commit()
    out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 9. reset_lane
# Clear action, status, live fields, logs. Keep pcb_serial_no, latest_result_id.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "reset_lane":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()
    lane_no = int(payload.get("lane_no") or 0)

    if not docname or not lane_no:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname / lane_no")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    row = get_lane_row(doc, lane_no)
    child_dt = frappe.get_meta("PTS3 Test").get_field("lanes").options

    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_action_status", "Idle", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "run_id", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "connector_name", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_heartbeat_at", None, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "abort_requested", 0, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_graph_json", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_table_json", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_status", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_freq", 0, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_current_mode", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "live_progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "last_live_update_at", None, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "lane_log", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "progress_message", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "error_message", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "pass_fail", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "dominant_channel", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "max_value", None, update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.set_value(child_dt, row.name, "mode_values_json", "", update_modified=False)
    frappe.db.commit()
    out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd}

# ============================================================
# 10. get_status_snapshot
# Return full doc and lanes for UI refresh.
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "get_status_snapshot":
    docname = (payload.get("docname") or "").strip()

    if not docname:
        frappe.throw("Missing docname")

    doc = get_pts3_doc(docname)
    lanes = []
    for r in (doc.lanes or []):
        lanes.append({
            "lane_no": r.lane_no,
            "pcb_serial_no": r.pcb_serial_no or "",
            "lane_action": r.lane_action or "",
            "lane_action_status": r.lane_action_status or "",
            "run_id": r.run_id or "",
            "last_heartbeat_at": str(r.last_heartbeat_at) if r.last_heartbeat_at else "",
            "abort_requested": 1 if r.get("abort_requested") else 0,
            "live_graph_json": r.live_graph_json or "",
            "live_table_json": r.live_table_json or "",
            "live_status": r.live_status or "",
            "live_current_freq": r.live_current_freq or 0,
            "live_current_mode": r.live_current_mode or "",
            "live_progress_message": r.live_progress_message or "",
            "last_live_update_at": str(r.last_live_update_at) if r.last_live_update_at else "",
            "lane_log": (r.lane_log or "")[-4096:],
            "progress_message": r.progress_message or "",
            "error_message": r.error_message or "",
            "pass_fail": r.pass_fail or "",
            "dominant_channel": r.dominant_channel or "",
            "max_value": r.max_value,
            "mode_values_json": r.mode_values_json or "",
            "latest_result_id": r.latest_result_id or "",
        })
    out = {"ok": True, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "api_version": PTS3_API_VERSION, "doc": doc.as_dict(), "lanes": lanes}

# ============================================================
# 11. pts3_book_get
# Grouped history view per pcb_serial_no (PTS3 Result)
# Input: pcb_serial_no, limit, offset
# Output: pcb_serial_no, run_count, latest_run{}, runs[], has_more
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "pts3_book_get":
    pcb_serial_no = (payload.get("pcb_serial_no") or "").strip()
    try:
        limit = int(payload.get("limit") or 25)
    except Exception:
        limit = 25
    try:
        offset = int(payload.get("offset") or 0)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    if limit < 1:
        limit = 25
    if limit > 200:
        limit = 200
    if offset < 0:
        offset = 0

    if not pcb_serial_no:
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "pcb_serial_no_required"}
    else:
        # Count total runs (fast with index on pcb_serial_no)
        try:
            run_count = frappe.db.count("PTS3 Result", {"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no})
        except Exception:
            run_count = 0

        fields_full = [
            "name",
            "datetime",
            "operation",
            "pass_fail",
            "dominant_channel",
            "max_value",
            "run_id",
            "lane_no",
            "pts3_test_ref",
        ]
        fields_base = [
            "name",
            "datetime",
            "operation",
            "pass_fail",
            "dominant_channel",
            "max_value",
            "run_id",
        ]

        # No nested def / no leading "_" names — Server Script uses RestrictedPython.
        latest = None
        runs = []
        try:
            latest_rows = frappe.db.get_all(
                "PTS3 Result",
                filters={"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no},
                fields=fields_full,
                order_by="datetime desc, creation desc",
                limit_page_length=1,
            )
            if latest_rows and len(latest_rows) > 0:
                latest = latest_rows[0]
            runs = frappe.db.get_all(
                "PTS3 Result",
                filters={"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no},
                fields=fields_full,
                order_by="datetime desc, creation desc",
                limit_start=offset,
                limit_page_length=limit,
            ) or []
        except Exception:
            try:
                latest_rows = frappe.db.get_all(
                    "PTS3 Result",
                    filters={"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no},
                    fields=fields_base,
                    order_by="datetime desc, creation desc",
                    limit_page_length=1,
                )
                if latest_rows and len(latest_rows) > 0:
                    latest = latest_rows[0]
                runs = frappe.db.get_all(
                    "PTS3 Result",
                    filters={"pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no},
                    fields=fields_base,
                    order_by="datetime desc, creation desc",
                    limit_start=offset,
                    limit_page_length=limit,
                ) or []
            except Exception:
                latest = None
                runs = []

        has_more = False
        try:
            has_more = (offset + limit) < int(run_count or 0)
        except Exception:
            has_more = False

        out = {
            "ok": True,
            "api_cmd": api_cmd,
            "pcb_serial_no": pcb_serial_no,
            "run_count": run_count,
            "latest_run": latest,
            "runs": runs,
            "limit": limit,
            "offset": offset,
            "has_more": True if has_more else False,
        }

# ============================================================
# 12. pts3_book_list_serials
# Distinct pcb_serial_no with run counts (for PTS3 Book index table).
# Input: search (optional filter), limit, offset
# Output: serials[{pcb_serial_no, run_count}], distinct_count, has_more
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "pts3_book_list_serials":
    search = (payload.get("search") or "").strip()
    try:
        lim = int(payload.get("limit") or 50)
    except Exception:
        lim = 50
    try:
        off = int(payload.get("offset") or 0)
    except Exception:
        off = 0

    if lim < 1:
        lim = 50
    if lim > 500:
        lim = 500
    if off < 0:
        off = 0

    rows = []
    total_int = 0
    has_more = False

    try:
        if search:
            like = "%" + search + "%"
            rows = frappe.db.sql(
                """
                SELECT pcb_serial_no, COUNT(*) AS run_count
                FROM `tabPTS3 Result`
                WHERE pcb_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND pcb_serial_no != ''
                  AND pcb_serial_no LIKE %(like)s
                GROUP BY pcb_serial_no
                ORDER BY MAX(modified) DESC
                LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(off)s
                """,
                {"like": like, "limit": lim, "off": off},
                as_dict=True,
            )
            cnt = frappe.db.sql(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
                    SELECT pcb_serial_no FROM `tabPTS3 Result`
                    WHERE pcb_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND pcb_serial_no != ''
                      AND pcb_serial_no LIKE %(like)s
                    GROUP BY pcb_serial_no
                ) x
                """,
                {"like": like},
            )
            if cnt and len(cnt) > 0:
                total_int = int(cnt[0][0])
        else:
            rows = frappe.db.sql(
                """
                SELECT pcb_serial_no, COUNT(*) AS run_count
                FROM `tabPTS3 Result`
                WHERE pcb_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND pcb_serial_no != ''
                GROUP BY pcb_serial_no
                ORDER BY MAX(modified) DESC
                LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(off)s
                """,
                {"limit": lim, "off": off},
                as_dict=True,
            )
            cnt = frappe.db.sql(
                """
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pcb_serial_no) FROM `tabPTS3 Result`
                WHERE pcb_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND pcb_serial_no != ''
                """,
            )
            if cnt and len(cnt) > 0:
                total_int = int(cnt[0][0])
    except Exception:
        rows = []
        total_int = 0

    try:
        ti = int(total_int)
        has_more = (off + lim) < ti
    except Exception:
        has_more = False

    out = {
        "ok": True,
        "api_cmd": api_cmd,
        "serials": rows or [],
        "distinct_count": total_int,
        "limit": lim,
        "offset": off,
        "has_more": True if has_more else False,
    }

# ============================================================
# 13. pts3_book_get_result_graphs
# Load graph JSON fields for one PTS3 Result (for PTS3 Book charts).
# Input: result_name OR run_id (+ optional pcb_serial_no if run_id not unique)
# Output: name, run_id, operation, datetime, final_graph_json, mode_values_json, left_right_diff_summary_json
# ============================================================
elif api_cmd == "pts3_book_get_result_graphs":
    result_name = (payload.get("result_name") or "").strip()
    run_id = (payload.get("run_id") or "").strip()
    pcb_serial_no = (payload.get("pcb_serial_no") or "").strip()

    if (not result_name) and (not run_id):
        out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "result_name_or_run_id_required"}
    elif result_name:
        if not frappe.db.exists("PTS3 Result", result_name):
            out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "result_not_found"}
        else:
            d = frappe.get_doc("PTS3 Result", result_name)
            out = {
                "ok": True,
                "api_cmd": api_cmd,
                "name": d.name,
                "run_id": d.run_id or "",
                "operation": d.operation or "",
                "datetime": str(d.datetime) if d.datetime else "",
                "final_graph_json": d.final_graph_json or "",
                "mode_values_json": d.mode_values_json or "",
                "left_right_diff_summary_json": d.left_right_diff_summary_json or "",
            }
    else:
        filt = {"run_id": run_id}
        if pcb_serial_no:
            filt["pcb_serial_no"] = pcb_serial_no
        rows = frappe.get_all(
            "PTS3 Result",
            filters=filt,
            fields=["name"],
            order_by="modified desc",
            limit_page_length=1,
        )
        if not rows:
            out = {"ok": False, "api_cmd": api_cmd, "reason": "run_not_found"}
        else:
            d = frappe.get_doc("PTS3 Result", rows[0].name)
            out = {
                "ok": True,
                "api_cmd": api_cmd,
                "name": d.name,
                "run_id": d.run_id or "",
                "operation": d.operation or "",
                "datetime": str(d.datetime) if d.datetime else "",
                "final_graph_json": d.final_graph_json or "",
                "mode_values_json": d.mode_values_json or "",
                "left_right_diff_summary_json": d.left_right_diff_summary_json or "",
            }

# ============================================================
# Unknown api_cmd
# ============================================================
else:
    frappe.throw("Invalid api_cmd: " + str(api_cmd))

frappe.response["message"] = out

### AI  ``

In your PTS3 script the **vertical “candles”** (the three columns per mode: Left / Right / Difference) get their **horizontal width** from layout math, then from one knob you already have.

### Main knob: `candleWidthScale` (in `MODE_HBAR`)

```97:98:c:\Users\pc\Desktop\PCB_IQC_ERPNext_Project\EXAMPLES\CHARGPT  TRIAL\PTS3 test\pts3_result_client_script.js
    /** Multiplier on bar width after layout (then clamped to fit the group slot). */
    candleWidthScale: 1,
```

- **`1`** = default width.  
- **`1.2`**–**`1.4`** = noticeably **wider** candles (until they hit the clamp).  
- **`0.7`**–**`0.85`** = **thinner** candles.

Width is still **capped** so the three bars + gaps stay inside each mode’s column (see the `clusterW > groupSlotW` block around lines 893–897).

### Other things that change candle width indirectly

| Setting | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| **`plotWidth`** | Larger → more horizontal space per mode group → wider possible candles. |
| **`candleGroupGap`** | **Smaller** → more width left for each group → candles can be wider. |
| **`candleInnerGap`** (or **`innerGap`** if `candleInnerGap` is `null`) | **Smaller** gap between the three bars → each bar can be **wider** for the same group width. |

So: for “wider candles” without touching layout much, raise **`candleWidthScale`** first; if it doesn’t grow enough, **lower `candleGroupGap`** or **increase `plotWidth`**, or **lower `candleInnerGap` / `innerGap`**.

### AI  ``

Identifying issues:
1. Access violation after Mode 0 — each ERP mode run spawns a new Python process that reopens the USB scope; closing then immediately reopening can crash NI-VISA on Python 3.13.
2. DC coupling — our code defaults to DC; we'll restore AC as default and only re-apply coupling on the first configure per scope session.
3. `*OPC?` — can destabilize some VISA stacks — make it opt-in.

Implementing: lighter repeat `configure()` (coupling once per `Oscilloscope` instance), remove default `*OPC?`, default coupling AC, and add a short post-close delay before the process exits.
